news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 5: Coaching rivalries, divisional shakeups, potential Super Bowl preview
news_mentions.body_text: the athletic has live coverage of all of nfl week 5 39 s games including eagles vs jaguars in london the nfl regular season is taking shape with four weeks of action complete plenty can change and quickly but contenders seem to be starting to distinguish themselves intrigue also continues to build as many teams 39 seasons could still go either way and then there are clubs where desperation has set in after disastrous starts one such team the tampa bay buccaneers kicked off week 5 with a thursday night date with the cowboys in dallas behind an impressive outing from undrafted rookie quarterback jalon daniels and a disruptive effort from coach todd bowles 39 defense the buccaneers ended their 0 4 skid with a shocking upset sunday 39 s slate kicks off in london with the philadelphia eagles and jacksonville jaguars eleven more games follow before sunday night 39 s matchup between the baltimore ravens and atlanta falcons week 5 wraps up with monday 39 s much anticipated showdown between the buffalo bills and los angeles rams here are some leading storylines to watch relief in sight two of the four winless teams face off as the houston texans visit the tennessee titans barring a tie one of these clubs will snap its four game losing streak and receive a much needed reprieve from the tumult of the season 39 s first month the titans 39 rocky start isn 39 t a surprise as the franchise made another head coaching change this offseason the roster remains in rebuild mode and second year quarterback cam ward continues to work through growing pains ward put together one of his most productive games of the season last week against the ravens completing 64 5 percent of his passes for 222 yards and a touchdown but ball security issues a fumble and an interception overshadowed his progress in a nbsp 24 18 defeat ward seeks his first win over the texans after going 0 2 against the afc south rivals as a rookie these aren 39 t the texans we 39 re used to seeing however a usually ferocious defense has struggled mightily in 2026 surrendering 343 8 yards and 27 3 points per game after holding teams to 277 2 yards and 17 4 points per game last season as a result quarterback c j stroud and houston 39 s offense face even more pressure than usual wide receiver injuries have left stroud with limited weapons still last week 39 s return of top target nico collins seven catches 118 yards two touchdowns led to houston 39 s most prolific performance since week 1 however the texans couldn 39 t stop the cowboys and fell 34 30 coach demeco ryans has twice helped the texans rebound from slow starts to reach the postseason but at 0 4 history isn 39 t on houston 39 s side only one of 109 nfl teams that opened the season 0 4 qualified for the playoffs the 1992 san diego chargers however right now playoffs are the furthest thing from either team 39 s mind they 39 d like to get a win texans at titans 1 p m et cbs johnson vs lafleur nfc north rivals meet at lambeau field as the chicago bears visit the green bay packers as the league 39 s longest running rivalry 213 meetings dating back to 1921 these teams share deep familiarity and dislike for one another a budding rivalry also exists between chicago 39 s ben johnson and green bay 39 s matt lafleur generally regarded as two of the game 39 s brightest offensive minds lafleur 39 s packers have struggled out of the gate unable to run the football without josh jacobs and finding third downs virtually impossible to convert green bay ranks last by a healthy margin converting on only 26 1 percent of attempts green bay 39 s defense also has faltered on these money downs opponents convert third downs at 48 2 percent the fourth highest in the nfl lafleur will need more from quarterback jordan love who is completing a career low 56 5 percent of his passes and now faces a bears defense that ranks second on third down 23 7 percent conversion rate allowed and third in passing 179 8 yards allowed per game meanwhile johnson prepares tyson bagent for his second straight start at quarterback with star caleb williams still sidelined with a hamstring injury bagent completed 73 5 percent of his passes for 268 yards and an interception in last week 39 s 23 12 win over the new york jets chicago also leaned heavily on running back kyle monangai who racked up 30 carries for 146 yards and two touchdowns but monangai is out this week with a toe injury and is considered week to week by johnson the bears 3 1 and packers 2 2 split last season 39 s regular season series but chicago overcame an 18 point deficit to shock green bay in the wild card round bears at packers 1 p m et fox nfc east shakeup for most of the last decade the philadelphia eagles have dominated the nfc east winning the division five times including in three of the past four seasons and reaching the playoffs eight times in 10 years however the eagles find themselves in a precarious position entering the second quarter of the season injuries adjustments to a new offense and changes to the defensive coaching staff have hampered coach nick sirianni 39 s team from the start in week 4 the eagles entered the game with nine starters out and the rams capitalized on the collapse to make matters worse the team lost all pro right tackle lane johnson to an abrupt retirement this week and then traded center guard cam jurgens to the ravens things could get worse before they get better for philadelphia which travels to london to face the jaguars one of the league 39 s most well rounded teams meanwhile the new york giants have jumped out to a 3 1 start and hold sole possession of first place in the division for the first time since 2015 new coach john harbaugh is finding ways to overcome season ending injuries to starting quarterback jaxson dart and top pass rusher brian burns the giants will look to nbsp build on that momentum this weekend when they visit nbsp the battered washington commanders washington welcomes back starting nbsp quarterback jayden daniels from a left elbow dislocation but it still needs to address an injury and penalty plagued offensive line and a sputtering rushing attack if the giants keep winning behind backup turned starter jameis winston harbaugh 39 s team could build an early cushion that helps as the season progresses that 39 s especially true after the cowboys suffered an embarrassing loss to the previously winless buccaneers on thursday night dropping them to 2 3 eagles vs jaguars in london 9 30 a m et nfl network giants at commanders 1 p m et fox nfc west power struggle two of the league 39 s top teams who share a division square off sunday in seattle where the defending champion seahawks will host the undefeated san francisco 49ers this meeting should be one of the season 39 s most intriguing chess matches as offensive wizard kyle shanahan meets defensive mastermind mike macdonald who holds a 3 2 record against san francisco despite his strengths as an offensive architect and tactician shanahan has struggled against macdonald averaging 15 8 points per game in their four regular season contests and one postseason meeting shanahan has brock purdy and the offense off to an excellent start with the team ranking among the league 39 s top 10 in passing and rushing and averaging 30 5 points per game it 39 ll be interesting to see what shanahan does to remain a step ahead of macdonald and a seattle defense that ranks first in total defense 246 8 yards allowed per game second in takeaways eight and fifth in total defense 18 3 points allowed per game sam darnold has gone 1 1 since returning from the hip injury that knocked him out of the first quarter of the season opener he has six passing touchdowns and three interceptions in those games look for san francisco defensive coordinator raheem morris to dial up the pressure to force darnold into mistakes will seattle 3 1 find a way to cool off its nfc west rival or will san francisco 4 0 keep rolling 49ers at seahawks 4 25 p m et fox super bowl preview two potential contenders clash monday night as the rams 2 2 welcome the bills 3 1 to sofi stadium which also hosts super bowl lxi the current super bowl betting favorites the rams and bills have displayed both promise and doubt during the season 39 s first stanza despite their talent the rams have struggled to be consistent on offense but late in their comeback win over the eagles they showed their potential the defense delivered two defining stops and the offense moved the ball at will to secure a 24 20 win as for the bills their success hinges largely on the effectiveness of josh allen who should once again contend for mvp honors however joe brady 39 s offense badly needs support from a defense that underwent drastic offseason changes buffalo 39 s defense has allowed 26 8 points and 372 3 yards per game leaving allen and co with little margin for error this marks the first time these teams have met since the 44 42 shootout the rams won in 2024 in that game allen threw three touchdown passes and ran for three more while matthew stafford threw two touchdown passes and kyren williams ran for two touchdowns fireworks could be in store again bills at rams 8 15 p m et monday espn this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 5 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Who takes the latest installment of the heated 49ers-Seahawks rivalry? Will the Patriots' resurgence continue against the upstart Raiders? Can the Bills get back on track by knocking off the Rams on Monday night? Check out the Week 5 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a week ago it felt like drake maye carried the weight of the world on his shoulders the 24 year old responded admirably playing his best game of the season to lead the patriots to a road upset of the previously unbeaten rival bills meanwhile in las vegas the raiders entered last week with a surprising 3 0 record that some attributed to underwhelming competition how would the silver and black fare against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard fought rivalry win so are the patriots back are the raiders for real i answer both questions with a definitive maybe look all of us teams and analysts alike are still feeling out this young season at this point both sides give reason to believe while also leaving room for doubt but the most established unit in this game is new england s defense combine that with my lingering skepticism of this kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively things won t get easier for kellen moore and tyler shough brian flores defense has blitzed on 70 5 of dropbacks this season and generated a 46 8 pressure rate both the highest marks since 2018 per ngs shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday heads should be cooler just as jonathan taylor is heating up the colts star rb carried his team to victory in london and is finding the end zone at a near league best clip if taylor can dictate sunday s game indy will come away with it daniel jones may be standing in the way a turnover machine in the past few weeks jones faces an opportunistic pittsburgh defense in week 5 one that has logged two takeaways in each of its first four games indianapolis hasn t won a game s turnover battle since november 2025 for two teams on the edge of the postseason discussion in the afc sunday s result could be critical down the line whoever takes care of the ball should come out ahead point pittsburgh why gennaro picked the texans seeing how tennessee has finished each of the last two seasons with a league low three wins nobody s too surprised the titans are 0 4 but the texans remaining winless in mid october that s utterly shocking especially with c j stroud playing his best football since his transcendent rookie campaign in 2023 houston s defense which entered this season with great expectations to be the league s preeminent stopping unit has fallen flat not only do the texans rank in the 20s in total defense scoring d epa play and a host of additional metrics but they can t close houston has held a lead in the final two minutes of three of its four losses the talent rich defense just cannot get that final stop it s truly confounding given the retention from last season s top ranked group with the texans season reaching a state of emergency head coach demeco ryans broke glass taking over defensive play calling duties for this week s divisional game i think this leads to a spirited effort against the league s last ranked total offense if houston can t get off the schneid against the only team that s yet to produce 300 yards in a game this season the texans are broken beyond repair why jeremy picked the commanders new york narrowly escaped a home loss to the cardinals last week surviving the full jameis winston experience with a field flipping pick six on the last play of the game the first place giants haven t played up to their 3 1 record so far this season against the 1 3 commanders the sides should even out washington is returning its star qb jayden daniels from a dislocated left elbow after it was forced to play athan kaliakmanis for the bulk of its international effort the commanders have a laundry list of injuries but daronte jones blitz happy front figures to give jameis winston fits with whoever takes the field washington s revamped o line will face a real test with new york s defensive front led by abdul carter and droy candidate arvell reese but the commanders have fared well against the giants in all forms since dan quinn took over 4 0 and should continue to do so sunday why dan picked the bears i need to see a defense slow down ben johnson s running game before i pick against the bears the sample size is still small in 2026 but chicago s 196 3 rush yards per game are the second most by any team in the last 40 seasons 2019 ravens 206 0 per nfl research the packers rank 28th against the run and they just lost one of their best players linebacker edgerrin cooper to a season ending achilles tear the contrast here is stark green bay averages 58 rush yards per game the fewest in the league it seems well within the realm of possibility that the bears absolutely dominate in time of possession for the third straight week if caleb williams fill in tyson bagent is mistake prone in his second start of the year the cheeseheads could feast he s going to see his share of pressures the packers blitz at the eighth highest rate in the league 39 3 but i m expecting the ground game to provide him another relatively stress free day why bobby picked the broncos a lot of the elements that could ve rendered this a precarious matchup for the broncos are balanced out by the chargers dealing with similar issues denver has scored only 13 first half points through four games requiring a pair of comebacks from double digit deficits just to be sitting at 2 2 unless sean payton taking over play calling from first year offensive coordinator davis webb drastically changes those early game woes the broncos will remain vulnerable to opponents jumping out to sizeable leads luckily for denver the chargers haven t proven to be capable of doing that thus far they only cracked the 20 point mark for the first time last week the broncos could also be without their two top cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss rib but los angeles will be dealing with absences at both offensive tackle spots joe alt neck and rashawn slater ankle are both set to miss the contest as long as denver manufactures pressure against justin herbert who has experienced a nightmare start to the campaign the defense should be able to make life easier on its corners stepping into expanded roles with this being a divisional matchup the result could still end up closer than the records and general vibes suggest but that s technically another point in the broncos favor they tend to wake up and thrive in the clutch why brooke picked the lions after a hot start in week 1 the cardinals certainly have cooled off they have allowed at least 30 points in each of their last three games fortunately one of the three teams allowing more points per game this season is this week s opponent the lions who have scored and allowed 24 plus points in all four games simply put expect plenty of offense and fantasy points in this one the lions pick your poison unit with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown jameson williams and sam laporta in tow should have no problem rebounding from last week s roller coaster loss in carolina jacoby brissett has done some good things too notably when targeting trey mcbride and michael wilson the cardinals must find the end zone to stay with the ever explosive lions but a few too many field goals by the home team will likely put them on the losing end why dan picked the seahawks i still believe in the seahawks defense even after some rough moments in the past couple weeks seattle still has allowed the fewest total yards per game 246 8 yards per play 4 0 and pass yards per game 144 8 while also tying for the most interceptions 6 in the league 49ers qb brock purdy is rightfully one of the top mvp candidates through week 4 the man hasn t been sacked yet but can he keep it going at lumen field he had just two touchdown passes four interceptions and a 72 5 passer rating in his three games against seattle last season the seahawks were the only 49ers opponent to stop purdy from throwing a td pass in 2025 and they did it twice in week 18 and in the divisional round there s no guarantee history will repeat itself and the seahawks are not operating like the finely tuned machine they were toward the end of last season it s probably going to take forcing a sam darnold error or two for san francisco to win but i m not banking on the team with the league s seventh lowest pressure rate 31 6 to discombobulate him why brooke picked the falcons is anyone better in prime time than bijan robinson not in my book though derrick henry might have something to say about that but god bless the schedule makers for giving us bijan thrice in night games over the first five weeks in atlanta s last two games road routs of green bay and new orleans he has rushed for 339 yards and four scores it feels like there s no stopping bijan at this juncture i expect a heavy dose of the run game from two of the league s top rushing attacks especially if lamar jackson doesn t suit up the two time mvp has an outside chance to play sunday night after sustaining an ankle injury in baltimore s last game if he can t go tyler huntley would make his first start of the season he s proven to be a capable backup winning both of his starts for the ravens in 2025 but will he do enough in the pass game to keep atlanta s defense from solely keying on henry stepping in for jackson in the second half last week huntley attempted only one pass of 10 or more air yards while three were short throws 0 9 yards and five occurred behind the line of scrimmage not sure that ll get the job done against a falcons offense that s scored with ease with michael penix under center if jackson is healthy and plays this becomes much harder to predict yet it s hard to go against these falcons right now editor s update ravens coach jesse minter announced on friday that lamar jackson has been ruled out of sunday s game extra note sunday would mark falcons left tackle jake matthews 200th consecutive start the longtime veteran exited monday night s game with a groin injury leaving the nfl s longest active consecutive starts streak in jeopardy this type of longevity is extremely rare and it ll be a real shame if he falls just short of such a milestone number monday oct 12 why dan picked the rams we saw last week that the bills have a get right defense for quarterbacks with buffalo allowing drake maye to have his best game of the season by far after a horrendous start to 2026 i m counting on matthew stafford to shake off his struggles 6 6 td int ratio against a defense that doesn t appear up to the challenge of covering puka nacua and davante adams the bills rank among the bottom 10 in scoring and total defense while los angeles ranks among the top 10 in both categories now if the rams keep trying to beat themselves with turnovers and poor special teams play we know josh allen will make them pay l a needed a fourth quarter rally to beat the eagles last week despite outgaining them 415 172 sean mcvay is too good a coach to have his team playing sloppy football for long though i don t like being in the position of picking against allen even though he has four giveaways in the last two games 3 ints 1 fumble lost but the rams look like the more well rounded squad at the moment thursday s game why bobby picked the cowboys defensive issues continue to plague dallas but the buccaneers don t have enough firepower to keep up with dak prescott and co regardless tampa bay is the only team this season that has amassed fewer than 200 net passing yards and 150 net rushing yards in every game heading into week 5 per nfl research just take a look at ceedee lamb versus the entire bucs wr corps lamb who collected 17 receptions for 189 yards and a touchdown in the cowboys 34 30 win over the texans now has 37 receptions 498 receiving yards 28 receiving first downs and four td catches chris godwin emeka egbuka ted hurst tez johnson and kameron johnson have combined for 44 receptions 501 receiving yards 22 receiving first downs and two td catches sure tampa bay could presumably home in on limiting lamb but that still leaves threats like george pickens jake ferguson and javonte williams to deal with home field advantage and history is also on dallas side as jalon daniels prepares for his second career start only one undrafted rookie qb in nfl history has ever started and recorded a win over the cowboys washington s ed rubbert during the 1987 strike that washington squad of replacement players provided inspiration for the replacements which won best picture at the 2001 oscars just kidding that was gladiator unfortunately shane falco isn t walking through the door for tampa bay visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Manuel Turizo to headline halftime show at 2026 NFL Madrid Game
news_mentions.description: The NFL announced that Manuel Turizo will headline the halftime show during the 2026 NFL Madrid Game between the Bengals and Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 8 at 3:30 p.m. CET (9:30 a.m. ET) from the Bernabéu Stadium.
news_mentions.body_text: the national football league announced today that manuel turizo will headline the halftime show during the 2026 nfl madrid game between the cincinnati bengals and atlanta falcons on sunday nov 8 at 3 30 p m cet 9 30 a m et from the bernabeu stadium the madrid performance will be part of a record seven halftime shows presented by american express staged across the 2026 nfl international games a lineup of live musical performances spanning seven countries and four continents as the league plays its most international games ever in a single season manuel turizo is one of colombia s most successful global music stars known for blending reggaeton pop and tropical influences into a distinctive sound that has earned billions of streams worldwide from breakout hit una lady como tu to chart topping singles such as la bachata el merengue vagabundo and copa vacia turizo has built an international following through genre spanning music and high profile collaborations following the release of his fifth studio album apambichao in 2026 manuel turizo continues to build on his status as one of latin music s most recognizable global artists his performance will bring that star power to one of europe s most iconic stadiums it s a pleasure to be part of the nfl halftime show in madrid said turizo we re going to have an amazing time with plenty of surprises for all the football fans let s turn it up and make it unforgettable madrid has quickly become an important stage for the nfl internationally and bringing manuel turizo to the bernabeu gives us the opportunity to build a halftime show with real cultural connection and global energy said tim tubito senior director of global game presentation music and entertainment at the nfl as one of latin music s most dynamic artists turizo reflects the energy creativity and international appeal we look for when creating these performances we look forward to delivering a show that feels made for madrid and gives fans an unforgettable moment on game day manuel turizo s full halftime performance will be broadcast live in spain on dazn cuatro and mediaset infinity limited edition merchandise celebrating manuel turizo s performance at the 2026 nfl madrid game will be available at nfl shops on gameday and league events during the week the league is committed to growing the game at every level across the country engaging with fans year round through partners programs and initiatives further information around the entertainment and fan events surrounding the 2026 nfl madrid game will follow soon the announcement follows the previously confirmed performances of the jonas brothers at the 2026 nfl melbourne game on thursday sept 10 at the melbourne cricket ground pedro sampaio and ricky martin at the 2026 nfl rio game on sunday sept 27 at maracana stadium ayra starr at the 2026 nfl london game on sunday oct 11 at tottenham hotspur stadium burna boy at the 2026 nfl paris game on sunday oct 25 at the stade de france cage the elephant at the 2026 nfl munich game on sunday nov 15 at fc bayern munich stadium and the warning at the 2026 nfl mexico city game on sunday nov 22 at estadio banorte ticket information for the 2026 nfl madrid game is available at nfl com madrid to stay up to date on all things nfl spain and for more on the 2026 nfl madrid game follow nflespana on instagram and tiktok sixty five regular season nfl games have been played outside the united states with melbourne london berlin munich frankfurt madrid dublin sao paulo rio mexico city and toronto having hosted games to date 2026 nfl international games designates a new market city for 2026 london u k two games in tottenham hotspur stadium one in wembley stadium madrid spain bernabeu stadium melbourne australia melbourne cricket ground mexico city mexico estadio banorte munich germany fc bayern munich arena paris france stade de france stadium rio de janeiro brazil maracana stadium

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) to start Sunday vs. Giants after missing two games
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will start for Washington against the visiting New York Giants on Sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow, coach Dan Quinn confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels is returning and not a moment to soon for his washington commanders daniels will start for washington against the visiting new york giants on sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow coach dan quinn confirmed friday quinn added that receiver stefon diggs hamstring won t be available for daniels in his return while terry mclaurin hamstring looked good in his return to practice friday anticipation for a potential daniels comeback came prior to washington s week 4 game in london against the indianapolis colts when he made the transatlantic flight with the team ultimately daniels was ruled out and his backup marcus mariota was injured in the defeat which dropped washington to 1 3 daniels who dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys practiced fully on wednesday and thursday a good indicator he d return sunday when he ll be backed up by seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis kaliakmanis made his impromptu debut in relief of mariota against the colts now daniels the ap nfl offensive rookie of the year in 2024 will be looked on to reverse course for washington which is coming off a disastrous 5 12 2025 that seems to be bleeding into 2026 daniels has missed 12 of the commanders last 21 games over two games this season he has largely underwhelmed completing 29 of 51 passes 56 9 for 260 yards and three touchdowns with 100 yards on 12 carries in a pair of defeats since joining the franchise as the no 2 overall selection of the 2024 nfl draft daniels is 14 12 as a starter the overwhelming majority of those wins came during his 12 4 rookie campaign that 24 season in which washington advanced to the nfc championship game seems like a lifetime ago now but the commanders have gone 4 8 without daniels in the past two years thus his return is a very welcomed one with further hope that he ll return to past phenomenal form against the first place giants 3 1

news_mentions.headline: Eagles vs. Jaguars: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 5 London game
news_mentions.description: Can Jacksonville use the first leg of its London trip to prove itself as the AFC's most complete team? How will Philadelphia's new-look O-line fare? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Eagles-Jaguars game in London.
news_mentions.body_text: tottenham hotspur stadium will be the crossroads for two teams heading in drastically different directions just a quarter of the way through the 2026 nfl season about to play 26 of their next 30 regular season games away from home the jaguars in their record 15th u k appearance are set to host the eagles for the second time in london philadelphia beat jacksonville in 2018 but there is little connective tissue from that game to either squad playing on sunday save for eagles k jake elliott and te zach ertz this year s jaguars are winners of two straight dispatching of afc rivals new england and cincinnati in impressive fashion meanwhile the eagles are coming off a pitiful performance against the rams in which jalen hurts offense went 0 for 12 on third down and subsequently lost a number of starters to injury trade and retirement though these 2025 division winners trajectories may currently seem opposed when jacksonville and philadelphia clash sunday on the prime meridian the game can go either way three must know storylines 1 are jaguars most complete team in afc liam coen made a point this summer to call out the supposed disrespect his jaguars get from the national media bemoaning the team s lack of coverage well here the jags are in their first of two straight solo windows on what amounts to home turf against an nfc stalwart will they re introduce themselves to the world as true super bowl contenders last time duval was in london it was in a similar scenario and the jaguars got their doors blown off by the rams 35 7 since that international letdown coen s jags have gone 12 3 including postseason and played as well as any organization in football this season jacksonville is the only team in the nfl that has allowed 20 or fewer points in every game its eight takeaways are tied for second most in the nfl with 2025 second overall pick travis hunter providing his first career interception a couple weeks ago on offense the jags are spreading the wealth as the only team in the league with five players boasting at least two touchdowns through four weeks jacksonville also paces the nfl with a league low four three and outs so far this season jacksonville isn t without its weaknesses it ranks 31st in passing yards per game allowed perhaps a credit to its big leads taken against cleveland and new england and has started games better than it s finished them but at 3 1 sitting atop an underperforming afc south division the jaguars can stake a claim through one fourth of the season as one of the league s best teams will they prove it to an international audience on sunday 2 will eagles new look offensive line answer the bell what a difference a week makes in the days after philadelphia posted just 172 total yards of offense its offensive line endured major upheaval first came cam jurgens entering concussion protocol on monday then it was the shock wave of lane johnson s abrupt retirement on tuesday followed by jurgens being shipped to baltimore on wednesday in a trade that netted philly a valuable 2028 second rounder seemingly overnight the o line has taken a new shape and there s no telling how it will play in its first game under the spotlight the new arrangement features in order left tackle jordan mailata the elder statesman at 29 second year left guard willie lampkin second year center jake majors who s filling for injured second year center drew kendall right guard tyler steen and rookie right tackle markel bell who surely hopes to be uncrackable in his new role as opposed to philly s other famous bell some have seen the jurgens trade as the eagles giving up on the 2026 season sending a versatile starter away for picks but howie roseman insisted this week that nothing has changed and philly wants to win this year the road forward starts on sunday against a jaguars defense led by dc anthony campanile that has stymied opponents this season jacksonville has accumulated 41 pressures without blitzing tied for fifth in the nfl per next gen stats while philly s o line as previously constructed allowed 12 sacks fourth most and a 43 2 pressure rate third highest per ngs life has been hard enough for the eagles without johnson alone since 2024 philly has averaged 4 8 yards per carry with johnson on the field compared to 4 0 without him the pressure is quite literally on how will philly respond 3 what will hunter do in london encore the most productive game of travis hunter s burgeoning career came last year in england the no 2 overall pick caught eight balls for 101 yards and a touchdown in a losing effort against the rams playing 64 of his 76 total snaps on offense he suffered a season ending knee injury in practice just days after the breakout performance in his return from injury hunter has been much less of a factor on the offensive side of the ball despite what his final game of 2025 may have suggested through four weeks hunter is playing nearly double the defensive snaps per game 43 8 in 2026 compared to 22 0 in 25 and to greater effect in addition to logging his first career int in week 3 hunter has posted a 59 2 passer rating against when targeted 85 4 in 25 his 58 8 completion percentage allowed in coverage is the best on the team among defenders with at least 10 targets per next gen stats so far he s played just 16 snaps on offense and last week hunter the so called dual threat dynamo played all 71 defensive snaps and none with trevor lawrence and the offense his 175 defensive snaps this year are already more than his total from his rookie season 154 with philly already limited personnel wise on offense jacksonville can probably afford to move hunter off of his defensive assignments and into some offensive packages but why ruin a good thing we ll see if the jags zag or stick with the plan in hunter s return to the united kingdom

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer
