news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a week ago it felt like drake maye carried the weight of the world on his shoulders the 24 year old responded admirably playing his best game of the season to lead the patriots to a road upset of the previously unbeaten rival bills meanwhile in las vegas the raiders entered last week with a surprising 3 0 record that some attributed to underwhelming competition how would the silver and black fare against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard fought rivalry win so are the patriots back are the raiders for real i answer both questions with a definitive maybe look all of us teams and analysts alike are still feeling out this young season at this point both sides give reason to believe while also leaving room for doubt but the most established unit in this game is new england s defense combine that with my lingering skepticism of this kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively things won t get easier for kellen moore and tyler shough brian flores defense has blitzed on 70 5 of dropbacks this season and generated a 46 8 pressure rate both the highest marks since 2018 per ngs shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday heads should be cooler just as jonathan taylor is heating up the colts star rb carried his team to victory in london and is finding the end zone at a near league best clip if taylor can dictate sunday s game indy will come away with it daniel jones may be standing in the way a turnover machine in the past few weeks jones faces an opportunistic pittsburgh defense in week 5 one that has logged two takeaways in each of its first four games indianapolis hasn t won a game s turnover battle since november 2025 for two teams on the edge of the postseason discussion in the afc sunday s result could be critical down the line whoever takes care of the ball should come out ahead point pittsburgh why gennaro picked the texans seeing how tennessee has finished each of the last two seasons with a league low three wins nobody s too surprised the titans are 0 4 but the texans remaining winless in mid october that s utterly shocking especially with c j stroud playing his best football since his transcendent rookie campaign in 2023 houston s defense which entered this season with great expectations to be the league s preeminent stopping unit has fallen flat not only do the texans rank in the 20s in total defense scoring d epa play and a host of additional metrics but they can t close houston has held a lead in the final two minutes of three of its four losses the talent rich defense just cannot get that final stop it s truly confounding given the retention from last season s top ranked group with the texans season reaching a state of emergency head coach demeco ryans broke glass taking over defensive play calling duties for this week s divisional game i think this leads to a spirited effort against the league s last ranked total offense if houston can t get off the schneid against the only team that s yet to produce 300 yards in a game this season the texans are broken beyond repair why jeremy picked the commanders new york narrowly escaped a home loss to the cardinals last week surviving the full jameis winston experience with a field flipping pick six on the last play of the game the first place giants haven t played up to their 3 1 record so far this season against the 1 3 commanders the sides should even out washington is returning its star qb jayden daniels from a dislocated left elbow after it was forced to play athan kaliakmanis for the bulk of its international effort the commanders have a laundry list of injuries but daronte jones blitz happy front figures to give jameis winston fits with whoever takes the field washington s revamped o line will face a real test with new york s defensive front led by abdul carter and droy candidate arvell reese but the commanders have fared well against the giants in all forms since dan quinn took over 4 0 and should continue to do so sunday why dan picked the bears i need to see a defense slow down ben johnson s running game before i pick against the bears the sample size is still small in 2026 but chicago s 196 3 rush yards per game are the second most by any team in the last 40 seasons 2019 ravens 206 0 per nfl research the packers rank 28th against the run and they just lost one of their best players linebacker edgerrin cooper to a season ending achilles tear the contrast here is stark green bay averages 58 rush yards per game the fewest in the league it seems well within the realm of possibility that the bears absolutely dominate in time of possession for the third straight week if caleb williams fill in tyson bagent is mistake prone in his second start of the year the cheeseheads could feast he s going to see his share of pressures the packers blitz at the eighth highest rate in the league 39 3 but i m expecting the ground game to provide him another relatively stress free day why bobby picked the broncos a lot of the elements that could ve rendered this a precarious matchup for the broncos are balanced out by the chargers dealing with similar issues denver has scored only 13 first half points through four games requiring a pair of comebacks from double digit deficits just to be sitting at 2 2 unless sean payton taking over play calling from first year offensive coordinator davis webb drastically changes those early game woes the broncos will remain vulnerable to opponents jumping out to sizeable leads luckily for denver the chargers haven t proven to be capable of doing that thus far they only cracked the 20 point mark for the first time last week the broncos could also be without their two top cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss rib but news_mentions.description: Who takes the latest installment of the heated 49ers-Seahawks rivalry? Will the Patriots' resurgence continue against the upstart Raiders? Can the Bills get back on track by knocking off the Rams on Monday night? Check out the Week 5 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers-Cowboys on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Tampa Bay's 24-16 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon identifies the top takeaways from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' 24-16 victory over the Dallas Cowboys for their first win of the 2026 season.
news_mentions.body_text: replacement glory undrafted free agent jalon daniels had a cinematic showing on thursday night making his second career start and doing so in prime time against one of the most popular teams in north american sports daniels didn t let the moment get too big for him instead he was too fast for the cowboys too poised and too good daniels became only the second udfa quarterback to start and defeat the cowboys joining washington s ed rubbert in 1987 that game was also a prime time affair a memorable monday night amid a strike shortened season in which washington s replacement players bested dallas it was the inspiration for the movie the replacements on this evening daniels did his best shane falco impression from the start he scrambled like a madman from the opening drive fearless and fast holding the ball a bit too long but it didn t matter on an odyssey of a 15 play 73 yard march daniels rushed twice for 11 yards and was 8 of 8 passing for 49 yards including a 5 yard touchdown pass to bucky irving in his first start filling in for an injured baker mayfield a close loss last week to the green bay packers daniels looked overwhelmed at times but showed promise in this one daniels completed 19 of 25 pass attempts for 189 yards the td and rushed for 23 yards but more impressively he ignited a stagnant 28th ranked total offense and an 0 4 squad to its first win and the offense s finest performance of the year mayfield will heal up and return but this glorious showing from daniels will be remembered for quite some time deplorable night from dallas d a porous defense that was viewed as the 2025 cowboys downfall is an ill that isn t close to being remedied in 2026 at home facing a lowly ranked buccaneers offense with an undrafted rookie at the helm dallas conceivably was looking at a get right game instead this was a prime time viewing of all that s wrong tampa bay racked up a season high 419 yards of offense while playing turnover free ball for the first time this year once upon a time an all pro daron bland allowed three receptions on five targets for 91 yards dropped potential pick six was dreadful and fellow cornerback reddy steward five receptions on five targets for 25 yards td wasn t much better new addition joey porter could ve helped but he was ruled out prior to the game due to an illness jalon daniels was pressured just seven times and the bucs rushed for 241 yards after the bucs lengthy opening drive they were held scoreless in the first half but erupted in the second half tampa obliterated and embarrassed the cowboys scoring touchdowns on back to back drives that took just seven plays and equated to 161 yards and 14 points the bucs added a field goal on their third drive of the latter half and this looked like a laugher the closeness of the final score doesn t truly encapsulate just how problematic dallas defense looked again bad night for bowles todd bowles and the buccaneers avoided the franchise s first 0 5 start since 2013 but the night didn t end well in more ways than one most concerning was that bowles went down to a knee on the sidelines during the end of the game in a concerning scene prior to that he made a call that awoke a sleeping cowboys offensive giant and nearly squandered a stellar buccaneers night with tampa leading 24 10 with 8 36 to play bowles elected to go for it on fourth and goal from the cowboys 1 yard line a field goal would have put the bucs up by three scores and seemingly salted away a win instead bowles said go for it and sean tucker was stuffed the buccaneers head coach is known for being aggressive on defense that paid off thursday as dak prescott looked out of sync for the majority of the night however his unconventional aggression when it comes to rolling the dice on the offensive side of the ball threw the cowboys a life preserver prescott and co responded with a 10 play 99 yard td drive a prescott incompletion on the two point try gave the bucs an eight point cushion but tampa bay s offense had lost its mojo and went three and out to give the cowboys one more chance alex anzalone s interception on a tipped ball sealed the victory but there was no reason for tampa to have to escape with this one dak and co lost in lights ugly as the cowboys defensive performance was dak prescott and the offense weren t much prettier it started well enough when dallas marched 70 yards on nine plays to score on the game s first drive but after that the cowboys were held to three points over their next seven drives prescott looked out of sorts and ceedee lamb coming off a career best 17 reception showing was held to one catch for 4 yards in the opening half more problematic was he left early with a quad injury late in the game the body language and expressions of the cowboys on the sidelines looked like those of a team down 44 10 rather than 24 10 when the cowboys held the bucs on fourth and goal prescott and his squad were clearly awoken but it wasn t to be they had three total turnovers and were stymied by the bucs blitz and stellar games in coverage by the zyon mccollum and jacob parrish parrish gave up some big plays late but for the most part the bucs defense came to play and the cowboys offense did not big night for bucky jalon daniels was the feel good story for tampa but bucky irving was the engine driving them irving was stellar to the tune of a career high 165 rushing yards and two total touchdowns unbelievably it was the third year back s first career game with multiple touchdowns 5 yard td catch in second quarter 1 yard run in third quarter his biggest play was the nfl s second longest rush of the season in which he wiggled around some shoddy cowboys tackling for a 72 yard run on the opening play from scrimmage in the second half on the next play emeka egbuka scored his first career rushing td on a 14 yard end around on the bucs final drive it was irving who clinched it after anzalone s pick once more irving broke loose gaining 22 yards on second and 12 to allow daniels to kneel away the win if irving can hit his stride against defenses of a better ilk than the cowboys it bodes huge for the bucs next gen stats insight for buccaneers cowboys via nfl pro bucky s irving s 72 yard run in the third quarter the second longest rush of the season covered a total distance of 90 50 yards and saw irving reach a top speed of 20 43 mph nfl research tampa bay s first offensive drive in which bucky irving caught a 5 yard touchdown on the 15th play encompassed 73 yards and 10 minutes 58 seconds it was the longest drive in terms of time elapsed for tampa bay since nov 4 2007 against the arizona cardinals 11 59 it was the third longest buccaneers drive since 2000

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 4 games: Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) exit
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 4 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 4 sunday arizona cardinals safety andrew wingard knee and guard isaiah adams ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the giants tight end hunter long knee did not return offensive tackle paris johnson suffered a biceps injury and was wearing a sling in the locker room following the game per espn baltimore ravens cornerback marlon humphrey calf was ruled out of sunday s win over the titans quarterback lamar jackson ankle did not return buffalo bills wide receiver dj moore aggravated his shoulder injury in sunday s loss to the patriots but it is not currently considered a long term issue espn s adam schefter reported defensive back te 39 cory couch hamstring defensive lineman ed oliver knee and cornerback dee alford ankle did not return carolina panthers offensive tacklemonroe freeling knee was injured in the third quarter and later ruled out chicago bears running back kyle monangai injured his thumb in sunday s win over the jets head coach ben johnson said cincinnati bengals wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was ruled out after he suffered a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to the jaguars denver broncos cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss ribs were ruled out of sunday s loss to the 49ers wide receiver pat bryant ankle was carted to the locker room in the third quarter and did not return head coach sean payton did not have any injury updates following the game detroit lions cornerback rock ya sin left sunday night s game with a hamstring injury green bay packers linebacker edgerrin cooper achilles was ruled out of sunday s win over tampa bay head coach matt lafleur told reporters after the game that he suspects that cooper will miss the remainder of the season cornerback brandon cisse neck did not return and was evaluated for a concussion houston texans cornerback jaylin smith hamstring was ruled out of sunday s loss to dallas jacksonville jaguars safety caleb ransaw knee did not return to sunday s win over the bengals kansas city chiefs wide receiver rashee rice hamstring was injured in the first quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the raiders head coach andy reid described rice s injury as a tweak wide receiver tyquan thornton who was carted off the field during sunday s game suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday night thornton will undergo a full evaluation monday morning and is out indefinitely las vegas raiders wide receiver jalen nailor concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the chiefs los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey foot and offensive tackle joe alt neck were ruled out of sunday s loss to the seahawks offensive tackle rashawn slater ankle and cornerback donte jackson hamstring did not return los angeles rams wide receiver konata mumpfield shoulder did not return to sunday s win over philadelphia miami dolphins defensive back reese taylor quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to the vikings minnesota vikings offensive lineman donovan jackson knee was ruled out of sunday s win over the dolphins offensive lineman christian darrisaw was evaluated for a concussion in the second half and did not return new england patriots wide receiver mack hollins calf and tight end eli raridon ankle did not return to sunday s win over the bills new york giants wide receiver braxton berrios foot defensive lineman chauncey golston and safety jason pinnock were ruled out of sunday s win over arizona new york jets defensive end braiden mcgregor chest was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago philadelphia eagles running back saquon barkley hamstring was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the rams linebacker jonathan greenard ankle was ruled out in the second half cornerback quinyon mitchell knee did not return following the loss head coach nick sirianni would not expand on right tackle lane johnson being inactive due to personal reasons telling reporters he s dealing with a personal matter and that s all i m going to say on that san francisco 49ers fullback kyle juszczyk knee is believed to be dealing with a sprain after he was ruled out of sunday s win over the broncos head coach kyle shanahan said jusczcyk will undergo more testing monday per shanahan cornerback upton stout shoulder will undergo testing monday per shanahan seattle seahawks defensive tackle leonard williams left in the middle of the fourth quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the chargers head coach mike macdonald told reporters postgame that the team will have to see about williams but his injury does not appear serious tampa bay buccaneers linebacker sirvocea dennis ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the packers washington commanders quarterback marcus mariota knee defensive end charles omenihu groin and wide receiver jaylin lane ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the colts mariota knee was replaced by athan kaliakmanis in the first quarter tyler owens hamstring did not return

news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a week ago it felt like drake maye carried the weight of the world on his shoulders the 24 year old responded admirably playing his best game of the season to lead the patriots to a road upset of the previously unbeaten rival bills meanwhile in las vegas the raiders entered last week with a surprising 3 0 record that some attributed to underwhelming competition how would the silver and black fare against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard fought rivalry win so are the patriots back are the raiders for real i answer both questions with a definitive maybe look all of us teams and analysts alike are still feeling out this young season at this point both sides give reason to believe while also leaving room for doubt but the most established unit in this game is new england s defense combine that with my lingering skepticism of this kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively things won t get easier for kellen moore and tyler shough brian flores defense has blitzed on 70 5 of dropbacks this season and generated a 46 8 pressure rate both the highest marks since 2018 per ngs shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday heads should be cooler just as jonathan taylor is heating up the colts star rb carried his team to victory in london and is finding the end zone at a near league best clip if taylor can dictate sunday s game indy will come away with it daniel jones may be standing in the way a turnover machine in the past few weeks jones faces an opportunistic pittsburgh defense in week 5 one that has logged two takeaways in each of its first four games indianapolis hasn t won a game s turnover battle since november 2025 for two teams on the edge of the postseason discussion in the afc sunday s result could be critical down the line whoever takes care of the ball should come out ahead point pittsburgh why gennaro picked the texans seeing how tennessee has finished each of the last two seasons with a league low three wins nobody s too surprised the titans are 0 4 but the texans remaining winless in mid october that s utterly shocking especially with c j stroud playing his best football since his transcendent rookie campaign in 2023 houston s defense which entered this season with great expectations to be the league s preeminent stopping unit has fallen flat not only do the texans rank in the 20s in total defense scoring d epa play and a host of additional metrics but they can t close houston has held a lead in the final two minutes of three of its four losses the talent rich defense just cannot get that final stop it s truly confounding given the retention from last season s top ranked group with the texans season reaching a state of emergency head coach demeco ryans broke glass taking over defensive play calling duties for this week s divisional game i think this leads to a spirited effort against the league s last ranked total offense if houston can t get off the schneid against the only team that s yet to produce 300 yards in a game this season the texans are broken beyond repair why jeremy picked the commanders new york narrowly escaped a home loss to the cardinals last week surviving the full jameis winston experience with a field flipping pick six on the last play of the game the first place giants haven t played up to their 3 1 record so far this season against the 1 3 commanders the sides should even out washington is returning its star qb jayden daniels from a dislocated left elbow after it was forced to play athan kaliakmanis for the bulk of its international effort the commanders have a laundry list of injuries but daronte jones blitz happy front figures to give jameis winston fits with whoever takes the field washington s revamped o line will face a real test with new york s defensive front led by abdul carter and droy candidate arvell reese but the commanders have fared well against the giants in all forms since dan quinn took over 4 0 and should continue to do so sunday why dan picked the bears i need to see a defense slow down ben johnson s running game before i pick against the bears the sample size is still small in 2026 but chicago s 196 3 rush yards per game are the second most by any team in the last 40 seasons 2019 ravens 206 0 per nfl research the packers rank 28th against the run and they just lost one of their best players linebacker edgerrin cooper to a season ending achilles tear the contrast here is stark green bay averages 58 rush yards per game the fewest in the league it seems well within the realm of possibility that the bears absolutely dominate in time of possession for the third straight week if caleb williams fill in tyson bagent is mistake prone in his second start of the year the cheeseheads could feast he s going to see his share of pressures the packers blitz at the eighth highest rate in the league 39 3 but i m expecting the ground game to provide him another relatively stress free day why bobby picked the broncos a lot of the elements that could ve rendered this a precarious matchup for the broncos are balanced out by the chargers dealing with similar issues denver has scored only 13 first half points through four games requiring a pair of comebacks from double digit deficits just to be sitting at 2 2 unless sean payton taking over play calling from first year offensive coordinator davis webb drastically changes those early game woes the broncos will remain vulnerable to opponents jumping out to sizeable leads luckily for denver the chargers haven t proven to be capable of doing that thus far they only cracked the 20 point mark for the first time last week the broncos could also be without their two top cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss rib but los angeles will be dealing with absences at both offensive tackle spots joe alt neck and rashawn slater ankle are both set to miss the contest as long as denver manufactures pressure against justin herbert who has experienced a nightmare start to the campaign the defense should be able to make life easier on its corners stepping into expanded roles with this being a divisional matchup the result could still end up closer than the records and general vibes suggest but that s technically another point in the broncos favor they tend to wake up and thrive in the clutch why brooke picked the lions after a hot start in week 1 the cardinals certainly have cooled off they have allowed at least 30 points in each of their last three games fortunately one of the three teams allowing more points per game this season is this week s opponent the lions who have scored and allowed 24 plus points in all four games simply put expect plenty of offense and fantasy points in this one the lions pick your poison unit with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown jameson williams and sam laporta in tow should have no problem rebounding from last week s roller coaster loss in carolina jacoby brissett has done some good things too notably when targeting trey mcbride and michael wilson the cardinals must find the end zone to stay with the ever explosive lions but a few too many field goals by the home team will likely put them on the losing end why dan picked the seahawks i still believe in the seahawks defense even after some rough moments in the past couple weeks seattle still has allowed the fewest total yards per game 246 8 yards per play 4 0 and pass yards per game 144 8 while also tying for the most interceptions 6 in the league 49ers qb brock purdy is rightfully one of the top mvp candidates through week 4 the man hasn t been sacked yet but can he keep it going at lumen field he had just two touchdown passes four interceptions and a 72 5 passer rating in his three games against seattle last season the seahawks were the only 49ers opponent to stop purdy from throwing a td pass in 2025 and they did it twice in week 18 and in the divisional round there s no guarantee history will repeat itself and the seahawks are not operating like the finely tuned machine they were toward the end of last season it s probably going to take forcing a sam darnold error or two for san francisco to win but i m not banking on the team with the league s seventh lowest pressure rate 31 6 to discombobulate him why brooke picked the falcons is anyone better in prime time than bijan robinson not in my book though derrick henry might have something to say about that but god bless the schedule makers for giving us bijan thrice in night games over the first five weeks in atlanta s last two games road routs of green bay and new orleans he has rushed for 339 yards and four scores it feels like there s no stopping bijan at this juncture i expect a heavy dose of the run game from two of the league s top rushing attacks especially if lamar jackson doesn t suit up the two time mvp has an outside chance to play sunday night after sustaining an ankle injury in baltimore s last game if he can t go tyler huntley would make his first start of the season he s proven to be a capable backup winning both of his starts for the ravens in 2025 but will he do enough in the pass game to keep atlanta s defense from solely keying on henry stepping in for jackson in the second half last week huntley attempted only one pass of 10 or more air yards while three were short throws 0 9 yards and five occurred behind the line of scrimmage not sure that ll get the job done against a falcons offense that s scored with ease with michael penix under center if jackson is healthy and plays this becomes much harder to predict yet it s hard to go against these falcons right now editor s update ravens coach jesse minter announced on friday that lamar jackson has been ruled out of sunday s game extra note sunday would mark falcons left tackle jake matthews 200th consecutive start the longtime veteran exited monday night s game with a groin injury leaving the nfl s longest active consecutive starts streak in jeopardy this type of longevity is extremely rare and it ll be a real shame if he falls just short of such a milestone number monday oct 12 why dan picked the rams we saw last week that the bills have a get right defense for quarterbacks with buffalo allowing drake maye to have his best game of the season by far after a horrendous start to 2026 i m counting on matthew stafford to shake off his struggles 6 6 td int ratio against a defense that doesn t appear up to the challenge of covering puka nacua and davante adams the bills rank among the bottom 10 in scoring and total defense while los angeles ranks among the top 10 in both categories now if the rams keep trying to beat themselves with turnovers and poor special teams play we know josh allen will make them pay l a needed a fourth quarter rally to beat the eagles last week despite outgaining them 415 172 sean mcvay is too good a coach to have his team playing sloppy football for long though i don t like being in the position of picking against allen even though he has four giveaways in the last two games 3 ints 1 fumble lost but the rams look like the more well rounded squad at the moment thursday s game why bobby picked the cowboys defensive issues continue to plague dallas but the buccaneers don t have enough firepower to keep up with dak prescott and co regardless tampa bay is the only team this season that has amassed fewer than 200 net passing yards and 150 net rushing yards in every game heading into week 5 per nfl research just take a look at ceedee lamb versus the entire bucs wr corps lamb who collected 17 receptions for 189 yards and a touchdown in the cowboys 34 30 win over the texans now has 37 receptions 498 receiving yards 28 receiving first downs and four td catches chris godwin emeka egbuka ted hurst tez johnson and kameron johnson have combined for 44 receptions 501 receiving yards 22 receiving first downs and two td catches sure tampa bay could presumably home in on limiting lamb but that still leaves threats like george pickens jake ferguson and javonte williams to deal with home field advantage and history is also on dallas side as jalon daniels prepares for his second career start only one undrafted rookie qb in nfl history has ever started and recorded a win over the cowboys washington s ed rubbert during the 1987 strike that washington squad of replacement players provided inspiration for the replacements which won best picture at the 2001 oscars just kidding that was gladiator unfortunately shane falco isn t walking through the door for tampa bay visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 4 games: Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) exit
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 4 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 4 sunday arizona cardinals safety andrew wingard knee and guard isaiah adams ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the giants tight end hunter long knee did not return offensive tackle paris johnson suffered a biceps injury and was wearing a sling in the locker room following the game per espn baltimore ravens cornerback marlon humphrey calf was ruled out of sunday s win over the titans quarterback lamar jackson ankle did not return buffalo bills wide receiver dj moore aggravated his shoulder injury in sunday s loss to the patriots but it is not currently considered a long term issue espn s adam schefter reported defensive back te 39 cory couch hamstring defensive lineman ed oliver knee and cornerback dee alford ankle did not return carolina panthers offensive tacklemonroe freeling knee was injured in the third quarter and later ruled out chicago bears running back kyle monangai injured his thumb in sunday s win over the jets head coach ben johnson said cincinnati bengals wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was ruled out after he suffered a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to the jaguars denver broncos cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss ribs were ruled out of sunday s loss to the 49ers wide receiver pat bryant ankle was carted to the locker room in the third quarter and did not return head coach sean payton did not have any injury updates following the game detroit lions cornerback rock ya sin left sunday night s game with a hamstring injury green bay packers linebacker edgerrin cooper achilles was ruled out of sunday s win over tampa bay head coach matt lafleur told reporters after the game that he suspects that cooper will miss the remainder of the season cornerback brandon cisse neck did not return and was evaluated for a concussion houston texans cornerback jaylin smith hamstring was ruled out of sunday s loss to dallas jacksonville jaguars safety caleb ransaw knee did not return to sunday s win over the bengals kansas city chiefs wide receiver rashee rice hamstring was injured in the first quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the raiders head coach andy reid described rice s injury as a tweak wide receiver tyquan thornton who was carted off the field during sunday s game suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday night thornton will undergo a full evaluation monday morning and is out indefinitely las vegas raiders wide receiver jalen nailor concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the chiefs los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey foot and offensive tackle joe alt neck were ruled out of sunday s loss to the seahawks offensive tackle rashawn slater ankle and cornerback donte jackson hamstring did not return los angeles rams wide receiver konata mumpfield shoulder did not return to sunday s win over philadelphia miami dolphins defensive back reese taylor quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to the vikings minnesota vikings offensive lineman donovan jackson knee was ruled out of sunday s win over the dolphins offensive lineman christian darrisaw was evaluated for a concussion in the second half and did not return new england patriots wide receiver mack hollins calf and tight end eli raridon ankle did not return to sunday s win over the bills new york giants wide receiver braxton berrios foot defensive lineman chauncey golston and safety jason pinnock were ruled out of sunday s win over arizona new york jets defensive end braiden mcgregor chest was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago philadelphia eagles running back saquon barkley hamstring was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the rams linebacker jonathan greenard ankle was ruled out in the second half cornerback quinyon mitchell knee did not return following the loss head coach nick sirianni would not expand on right tackle lane johnson being inactive due to personal reasons telling reporters he s dealing with a personal matter and that s all i m going to say on that san francisco 49ers fullback kyle juszczyk knee is believed to be dealing with a sprain after he was ruled out of sunday s win over the broncos head coach kyle shanahan said jusczcyk will undergo more testing monday per shanahan cornerback upton stout shoulder will undergo testing monday per shanahan seattle seahawks defensive tackle leonard williams left in the middle of the fourth quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the chargers head coach mike macdonald told reporters postgame that the team will have to see about williams but his injury does not appear serious tampa bay buccaneers linebacker sirvocea dennis ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the packers washington commanders quarterback marcus mariota knee defensive end charles omenihu groin and wide receiver jaylin lane ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the colts mariota knee was replaced by athan kaliakmanis in the first quarter tyler owens hamstring did not return
