news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 5 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Who takes the latest installment of the heated 49ers-Seahawks rivalry? Will the Patriots' resurgence continue against the upstart Raiders? Can the Bills get back on track by knocking off the Rams on Monday night? Check out the Week 5 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a week ago it felt like drake maye carried the weight of the world on his shoulders the 24 year old responded admirably playing his best game of the season to lead the patriots to a road upset of the previously unbeaten rival bills meanwhile in las vegas the raiders entered last week with a surprising 3 0 record that some attributed to underwhelming competition how would the silver and black fare against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard fought rivalry win so are the patriots back are the raiders for real i answer both questions with a definitive maybe look all of us teams and analysts alike are still feeling out this young season at this point both sides give reason to believe while also leaving room for doubt but the most established unit in this game is new england s defense combine that with my lingering skepticism of this kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively things won t get easier for kellen moore and tyler shough brian flores defense has blitzed on 70 5 of dropbacks this season and generated a 46 8 pressure rate both the highest marks since 2018 per ngs shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday heads should be cooler just as jonathan taylor is heating up the colts star rb carried his team to victory in london and is finding the end zone at a near league best clip if taylor can dictate sunday s game indy will come away with it daniel jones may be standing in the way a turnover machine in the past few weeks jones faces an opportunistic pittsburgh defense in week 5 one that has logged two takeaways in each of its first four games indianapolis hasn t won a game s turnover battle since november 2025 for two teams on the edge of the postseason discussion in the afc sunday s result could be critical down the line whoever takes care of the ball should come out ahead point pittsburgh why gennaro picked the texans seeing how tennessee has finished each of the last two seasons with a league low three wins nobody s too surprised the titans are 0 4 but the texans remaining winless in mid october that s utterly shocking especially with c j stroud playing his best football since his transcendent rookie campaign in 2023 houston s defense which entered this season with great expectations to be the league s preeminent stopping unit has fallen flat not only do the texans rank in the 20s in total defense scoring d epa play and a host of additional metrics but they can t close houston has held a lead in the final two minutes of three of its four losses the talent rich defense just cannot get that final stop it s truly confounding given the retention from last season s top ranked group with the texans season reaching a state of emergency head coach demeco ryans broke glass taking over defensive play calling duties for this week s divisional game i think this leads to a spirited effort against the league s last ranked total offense if houston can t get off the schneid against the only team that s yet to produce 300 yards in a game this season the texans are broken beyond repair why jeremy picked the commanders new york narrowly escaped a home loss to the cardinals last week surviving the full jameis winston experience with a field flipping pick six on the last play of the game the first place giants haven t played up to their 3 1 record so far this season against the 1 3 commanders the sides should even out washington is returning its star qb jayden daniels from a dislocated left elbow after it was forced to play athan kaliakmanis for the bulk of its international effort the commanders have a laundry list of injuries but daronte jones blitz happy front figures to give jameis winston fits with whoever takes the field washington s revamped o line will face a real test with new york s defensive front led by abdul carter and droy candidate arvell reese but the commanders have fared well against the giants in all forms since dan quinn took over 4 0 and should continue to do so sunday why dan picked the bears i need to see a defense slow down ben johnson s running game before i pick against the bears the sample size is still small in 2026 but chicago s 196 3 rush yards per game are the second most by any team in the last 40 seasons 2019 ravens 206 0 per nfl research the packers rank 28th against the run and they just lost one of their best players linebacker edgerrin cooper to a season ending achilles tear the contrast here is stark green bay averages 58 rush yards per game the fewest in the league it seems well within the realm of possibility that the bears absolutely dominate in time of possession for the third straight week if caleb williams fill in tyson bagent is mistake prone in his second start of the year the cheeseheads could feast he s going to see his share of pressures the packers blitz at the eighth highest rate in the league 39 3 but i m expecting the ground game to provide him another relatively stress free day why bobby picked the broncos a lot of the elements that could ve rendered this a precarious matchup for the broncos are balanced out by the chargers dealing with similar issues denver has scored only 13 first half points through four games requiring a pair of comebacks from double digit deficits just to be sitting at 2 2 unless sean payton taking over play calling from first year offensive coordinator davis webb drastically changes those early game woes the broncos will remain vulnerable to opponents jumping out to sizeable leads luckily for denver the chargers haven t proven to be capable of doing that thus far they only cracked the 20 point mark for the first time last week the broncos could also be without their two top cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss rib but los angeles will be dealing with absences at both offensive tackle spots joe alt neck and rashawn slater ankle are both set to miss the contest as long as denver manufactures pressure against justin herbert who has experienced a nightmare start to the campaign the defense should be able to make life easier on its corners stepping into expanded roles with this being a divisional matchup the result could still end up closer than the records and general vibes suggest but that s technically another point in the broncos favor they tend to wake up and thrive in the clutch why brooke picked the lions after a hot start in week 1 the cardinals certainly have cooled off they have allowed at least 30 points in each of their last three games fortunately one of the three teams allowing more points per game this season is this week s opponent the lions who have scored and allowed 24 plus points in all four games simply put expect plenty of offense and fantasy points in this one the lions pick your poison unit with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown jameson williams and sam laporta in tow should have no problem rebounding from last week s roller coaster loss in carolina jacoby brissett has done some good things too notably when targeting trey mcbride and michael wilson the cardinals must find the end zone to stay with the ever explosive lions but a few too many field goals by the home team will likely put them on the losing end why dan picked the seahawks i still believe in the seahawks defense even after some rough moments in the past couple weeks seattle still has allowed the fewest total yards per game 246 8 yards per play 4 0 and pass yards per game 144 8 while also tying for the most interceptions 6 in the league 49ers qb brock purdy is rightfully one of the top mvp candidates through week 4 the man hasn t been sacked yet but can he keep it going at lumen field he had just two touchdown passes four interceptions and a 72 5 passer rating in his three games against seattle last season the seahawks were the only 49ers opponent to stop purdy from throwing a td pass in 2025 and they did it twice in week 18 and in the divisional round there s no guarantee history will repeat itself and the seahawks are not operating like the finely tuned machine they were toward the end of last season it s probably going to take forcing a sam darnold error or two for san francisco to win but i m not banking on the team with the league s seventh lowest pressure rate 31 6 to discombobulate him why brooke picked the falcons is anyone better in prime time than bijan robinson not in my book though derrick henry might have something to say about that but god bless the schedule makers for giving us bijan thrice in night games over the first five weeks in atlanta s last two games road routs of green bay and new orleans he has rushed for 339 yards and four scores it feels like there s no stopping bijan at this juncture i expect a heavy dose of the run game from two of the league s top rushing attacks especially if lamar jackson doesn t suit up the two time mvp has an outside chance to play sunday night after sustaining an ankle injury in baltimore s last game if he can t go tyler huntley would make his first start of the season he s proven to be a capable backup winning both of his starts for the ravens in 2025 but will he do enough in the pass game to keep atlanta s defense from solely keying on henry stepping in for jackson in the second half last week huntley attempted only one pass of 10 or more air yards while three were short throws 0 9 yards and five occurred behind the line of scrimmage not sure that ll get the job done against a falcons offense that s scored with ease with michael penix under center if jackson is healthy and plays this becomes much harder to predict yet it s hard to go against these falcons right now editor s update ravens coach jesse minter announced on friday that lamar jackson has been ruled out of sunday s game extra note sunday would mark falcons left tackle jake matthews 200th consecutive start the longtime veteran exited monday night s game with a groin injury leaving the nfl s longest active consecutive starts streak in jeopardy this type of longevity is extremely rare and it ll be a real shame if he falls just short of such a milestone number monday oct 12 why dan picked the rams we saw last week that the bills have a get right defense for quarterbacks with buffalo allowing drake maye to have his best game of the season by far after a horrendous start to 2026 i m counting on matthew stafford to shake off his struggles 6 6 td int ratio against a defense that doesn t appear up to the challenge of covering puka nacua and davante adams the bills rank among the bottom 10 in scoring and total defense while los angeles ranks among the top 10 in both categories now if the rams keep trying to beat themselves with turnovers and poor special teams play we know josh allen will make them pay l a needed a fourth quarter rally to beat the eagles last week despite outgaining them 415 172 sean mcvay is too good a coach to have his team playing sloppy football for long though i don t like being in the position of picking against allen even though he has four giveaways in the last two games 3 ints 1 fumble lost but the rams look like the more well rounded squad at the moment thursday s game why bobby picked the cowboys defensive issues continue to plague dallas but the buccaneers don t have enough firepower to keep up with dak prescott and co regardless tampa bay is the only team this season that has amassed fewer than 200 net passing yards and 150 net rushing yards in every game heading into week 5 per nfl research just take a look at ceedee lamb versus the entire bucs wr corps lamb who collected 17 receptions for 189 yards and a touchdown in the cowboys 34 30 win over the texans now has 37 receptions 498 receiving yards 28 receiving first downs and four td catches chris godwin emeka egbuka ted hurst tez johnson and kameron johnson have combined for 44 receptions 501 receiving yards 22 receiving first downs and two td catches sure tampa bay could presumably home in on limiting lamb but that still leaves threats like george pickens jake ferguson and javonte williams to deal with home field advantage and history is also on dallas side as jalon daniels prepares for his second career start only one undrafted rookie qb in nfl history has ever started and recorded a win over the cowboys washington s ed rubbert during the 1987 strike that washington squad of replacement players provided inspiration for the replacements which won best picture at the 2001 oscars just kidding that was gladiator unfortunately shane falco isn t walking through the door for tampa bay visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Mike Ditka dies at age 86: Chicago Bears icon shaped NFL as Hall of Fame player, larger-than-life coach
news_mentions.description: Mike Ditka died on Friday at age 86. A Hall of Fame player, fiery coach and larger-than-life cultural figure, "Iron Mike" became a Chicago sports icon by lifting the Bears to their greatest heights.
news_mentions.body_text: a flat topped freight train from aliquippa pennsylvania mike ditka became a chicago sports icon he was a tight end made of iron a rumbling wrecking ball who cemented himself as one of the greatest at his position in nfl chronicle years later he returned to the second city as a coach a slick haired thick stached leader of men who was at the forefront of a 1985 bears super bowl triumph that stands as one of the most heralded seasons in league history he was iron mike he was da coach he was a hall of famer who died on friday ditka was 86 the death was announced by jarrett payton son of hall of fame running back walter payton who played under ditka in chicago it is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of our beloved husband father grandfather and friend mike ditka ditka s family said in a statement via jarrett payton while the world knew mike as a hall of fame football player legendary coach and leader of the chicago bears super bowl xx championship team we knew him as the heart of our family mike will be missed beyond measure and remembered forever enshrined into the pro football hall of fame in 1988 after a decorated playing career ditka was amid a storied coaching run with the bears at the time of his induction as a player he was a 1963 nfl champion with the bears and a super bowl vi winner with the cowboys he went on to claim a pair of super bowls in the coaching ranks winning super bowl xii as a dallas assistant under tom landry before he was carried off the field following the bears super bowl xx conquest in january of 1986 on the field ditka was a five time pro bowler and two time first team all pro who played 12 nfl seasons six with chicago two with philadelphia and four with dallas the 1961 associated press nfl rookie of the year ditka was later recognized as a member of the league s 75th anniversary and 100th anniversary all time teams his playing career spanned 158 regular season games producing 427 receptions for 5 812 receiving yards and 43 touchdowns ditka was an nfl head coach for 14 seasons 1982 1992 with the bears 1997 99 for the saints and was twice voted ap nfl coach of the year 1985 and 88 ditka produced a 121 95 career record he and fellow hall of famer tom flores stand as the only people to win super bowls as a player assistant coach and head coach we are deeply saddened by the passing of legendary and treasured chicago bear and pro football hall of famer mike ditka the bears said in a statement on friday mike s impact on the chicago bears organization over decades as a player coach and proud icon and ambassador for our organization is immeasurable his integral role in bringing world championships to our city and our franchise both as a player and as our coach established prominence and excellence at a world class level but also created a lifetime of cherished memories in the hearts and minds of bears fans that will last for generations after decades of competing in nfl ditka continued to entertain football fans by analyzing the league with his signature persona shining through the tv airwaves it was a fitting coda for an extraordinary football life mike ditka epitomized football over so many years he brought intensity authenticity and an unmistakable personality to everything he did nfl commissioner roger goodell said in a statement on friday as a hall of fame player super bowl winning coach with his beloved and iconic bears and as a broadcaster mike served as an ambassador for the game and inspired generations of fans through his work with the gridiron greats assistance fund mike was a champion for taking care of those who helped build our game we extend our deepest condolences to diana and the ditka family born on oct 18 1939 in carnegie pennsylvania ditka honed his toughness in the keystone state he starred at aliquippa high before shining in college at pittsburgh ditka was a first round pick of the bears in the 1961 nfl draft taken fifth overall and was the eighth overall pick of the 1961 afl draft selected by the oilers he chose chicago and made an instant impact piling up statistics from the get go and pulverizing the opposition in the process in 1961 ditka turned in one of the greatest debut seasons in nfl lore earning pro bowl honors right off the bat he set rookie te records in receptions 56 receiving yards 1 076 and receiving touchdowns 12 over 14 games with all three figures leading the entire league at the position keith jackson broke the receptions record in his rookie season of 1988 while brock bowers finally topped the yardage mark in 2024 63 years after ditka took the league by storm meanwhile ditka s td figure remains unmatched among rookie tight ends ditka still produced in phenomenal and standard setting fashion throughout his career but his rookie campaign would mark the only year in which he tallied 1 000 yards or double digit touchdowns nonetheless he led all nfl tight ends in receptions in each of his first four seasons for the position he was a statistical marvel but just as much regarded for his brutal blocking and the punishment he doled out to those who tried to stop him after a catch unfortunately for ditka whose bears teammates included future hall of famers like dick butkus gale sayers and bill george his individual greatness did not parallel team success on an annual basis during ditka s chicago tenure from 1961 1966 the bears logged one postseason appearance though they did make the most of it winning the nfl west division prior to besting the giants 14 10 in the nfl championship on dec 29 1963 at wrigley field it was the bears first nfl title since 1946 and they wouldn t claim another for 22 years with ditka playing a monumental role in that triumph as well across six autumns as a player in chicago ditka racked up 316 receptions 4 503 yards and 34 touchdowns averaging 52 7 catches for 750 5 yards and 5 7 tds per 14 game season iron mike never missed a game for the bears but he didn t feel his devotion and production were supported by his paycheck ahead of the 1967 season ditka was traded by the bears to the eagles though it wasn t exactly that simple with the nfl afl merger still to come ditka had inked a contract that offseason with the oilers who had originally selected him in that league s draft when the tight end was coming out of pitt ultimately the eagles picked up ditka s oilers contract and compensated the bears by shipping quarterback jack concannon to chicago in one of the earliest of many quips from ditka to the chicago press the tight end famously said of head coach and owner george halas that he threw nickels around like manhole covers in reference to halas frugalness ditka s days with the bears of course were far from over many of his finest chapters were still yet to be written as a player though ditka moved on from chicago and found his way to philadelphia his two seasons playing back in his home state were largely disappointing he played just 20 total games and it could be argued he wasn t the team s top tight end in either year as he was pushed by jim kelly and fred hill for that distinction ditka was traded again before the season of 69 this time to the cowboys who would prove pivotal in resurrecting his playing career and setting up his coaching days ditka s last four seasons as a player were spent in dallas with the initial three seeing him serve primarily as a backup still he contributed and was part of a pair of super bowl berths the franchise s first appearance a super bowl v loss to the colts and then the franchise s first win a super bowl vi victory over the dolphins in dallas 24 3 triumph over miami in january of 1972 ditka hauled in a 7 yard touchdown pass from roger staubach to put the finishing touches on the blowout ditka set a then franchise record for tes with 30 receptions in 1971 and then started all 14 games for the 1972 cowboys who made it to the nfc championship game in march of 1973 ditka announced his retirement as a player and was hired on to landry s staff as an assistant coach from 1973 through 1981 ditka was a mainstay coaching special teams and receivers along the way ditka collected a second super bowl ring as part of the cowboys 1977 championship squad which defeated the broncos 27 10 in super bowl xii after more than a decade with the cowboys as a player and an assistant ditka departed dallas and returned to chicago as head coach in 1982 ditka s bears homecoming saw him take over a franchise that had been to the playoffs just twice since he was part of the 1963 championship squad and had not won a postseason contest in that span a 3 6 showing in the strike shortened 82 campaign marked ditka s first season at the bears helm but a turnaround was afoot in 1984 the bears emerged as nfl heavyweights winning the nfc central for the first of five straight seasons and advancing to the nfc championship game where they lost to the eventual super bowl champion 49ers then came 1985 and a bears season that would see a cavalcade of chicago characters run roughshod over the league dominating foes entertaining fans from the windy city throughout the world and forming a champion that would live on in legend ditka s offense and buddy ryan s defense clashed at practice and the two coaches butted heads in decision making but amid the chaos a championship squad emerged boasting a slew of future hall of famers such as defensive linemen richard dent dan hampton and steve mcmichael linebacker mike singletary and one of the greatest of all time in running back walter payton the 85 bears had the talent to dominate and the personalities to garner headlines revered in chicago the bears were stars across the country and beyond as payton brash quarterback jim mcmahon and rookie defensive tackle part time fullback william refrigerator perry became commercial fixtures and ditka himself never shied away from endorsements all the hoopla and hype didn t deter domination the bears won their first 12 games in 1985 before suffering their only defeat of the season a 38 24 setback on monday night football to dan marino s dolphins after ravaging the giants and rams with shutout wins in the divisional round and nfc championship game respectively the bears expected to see the dolphins again in the super bowl instead they found the patriots who had upset miami in the afc title game having already walloped the pats 20 7 in week 2 of the regular season the bears were practically anointed champs before the game kicked off and chicago did indeed annihilate new england 46 10 which was the most lopsided victory in super bowl history at the time the defense bullied and battered the patriots forcing six turnovers recording seven sacks and allowing a meager 123 yards with just 7 on the ground the only unfortunate aspect of an otherwise sterling evening for the bears in new orleans spawned from the victors final touchdown a 1 yard rushing score by perry not payton for so long the man beloved by chicago and known as sweetness had carried the team through bleak seasons on this triumphant night though payton was bottled up as the patriots game plan clearly revolved around stopping the superstar back they did holding payton to just 61 yards on 22 carries but it opened up the rest of the offense that said when chicago got to first and goal at the 1 yard line late in the third quarter of a blowout many saw a perfect opportunity for payton to get his just due with a super bowl td instead ditka called perry s number giving the rookie d lineman a chance to celebrate it was an oft criticized decision that ditka eventually admitted he regretted it never ever crossed my mind now is that wrong of me yes probably it should ve crossed my mind but it didn t ditka said on espn s the 85 bears i didn t think it would ever mean anything to i think the greatest bear ever but then it did so i was wrong that i regret a lot i really do regret it a lot because i didn t realize it was important to him and it was very important to him nonetheless it was one of the greatest nights in chicago sports history as the bears celebrated their super bowl xx glory by carrying ditka and ryan off the field it was chicago s first major sports title in 22 years from 1984 88 the bears ran the nfc central winning the division each year but they followed their super bowl victory with back to back losses in the divisional round chicago returned to the nfc championship game in the 1988 campaign but lost to the eventual super bowl champion 49ers though the bears 85 team will forever live in nfl lore and is seen by some as the greatest super bowl champion of them all it was the niners who were the team of the 80s why ditka s bears were unable to win more than one title is an argument that will rage on for as long as the game is played in chicago days after the super bowl beatdown of new england ryan left to be the head coach of the eagles ditka and many of his players racked up endorsements and as their celebrity grew some believe success was taken for granted mcmahon s never say die playing style saw him injured often for whatever reason one lombardi was all the bears got after a 5 11 season in 1992 ditka s memorable run as bears head coach concluded with his firing this has been a kind of interesting day in my life ditka told reporters after his ouster as chronicled in the 85 bears i don t think i ve ever had one like this i hope i never have another one like this unfortunately for ditka he would after four years away from the sidelines ditka returned as head coach of the saints his three season run in the big easy was a big bust with his teams going a combined 15 33 his tenure with the saints will forever be linked to ricky williams williams was the saints only pick of the 1999 nfl draft as they traded the rest as well as their first and third round selections in the 2000 draft to move into the no 5 slot and nab the heisman trophy winning running back out of texas the two then famously appeared on the cover of espn the magazine dressed as bride williams in a wedding dress and groom ditka in a tuxedo the marriage lasted but one year as williams was plagued by injuries in his rookie campaign and ditka was dismissed following a three win season ditka would remain a staple on sundays but it was as a game day analyst he never coached again following his firing from the bears ditka joined nbc and after he was dismissed from the saints he headed to cbs he later made his way to espn and was a familiar face for years across the network s football coverage whether it be on nfl live sunday nfl countdown or monday night football ditka s tv time wasn t limited to commercials and nfl analysis though often playing himself ditka had guest appearances on tv shows such as coach according to jim entourage and even the series finale of cheers he also had a major part alongside will ferrell and robert duvall in the comedy film kicking screaming for all his fame as a player coach analyst and actor it s arguable that his legend grew largest on saturday night live when he wasn t even on the show cherished and idolized during bill swerski s superfans skits featuring joe mantegna george wendt chris farley mike myers and robert smigel ditka was da coach put alongside bulls superstar michael jordan as an unbeatable unconquerable being who transcended chicago sports for these parodied fanatics among windy city sports icons ditka the dynamic player the fiery coach remains one of the most revered and ironically nothing summed up ditka s passion for football better than his own words on the day he was fired by the bears i m no special deal ditka told reporters tears welling up his eyes mike ditka s a guy that came out of aliquippa came out of aliquippa in 1957 as a high school football player went to the university of pittsburgh and my life has been a miracle since because of this game

news_mentions.headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) out vs. Falcons; Tyler Huntley to start
news_mentions.description: There was reportedly an outside chance Lamar Jackson could play in Week 5. Now there's zero chance as Jackson has been ruled out ahead of the Ravens' game against the Falcons on Sunday night.
news_mentions.body_text: there was reportedly an outside chance lamar jackson could play in week 5 now there s zero chance as jackson has been ruled out ahead of the baltimore ravens game against the atlanta falcons on sunday night head coach jesse minter announced on friday tyler huntley will start in place of jackson minter also ruled out defensive end trey hendrickson for week 5 due to a finger injury jackson injured his ankle during the ravens week 4 win over the tennessee titans on monday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported jackson did not sustain a long term injury but the chance of him playing versus the falcons was slim with the two time ap nfl mvp being a non participant at practice throughout the week jackson s designation is hardly unexpected just how much time he ll miss will now be the prevailing question first though huntley will take the reins against a red hot falcons team it s hardly an unfamiliar situation for snoop who will make his 12th start for baltimore huntley is in his sixth season with the ravens and his second stint having played with the club from 2020 23 and rejoining them in 2025 after a year with the miami dolphins huntley is 7 9 in his career as a starter 5 6 with the ravens and 2 3 for the fins in relief of jackson against the titans huntley was 8 of 9 for 63 yards since jackson took over as the club s starter in week 11 of the 2018 season he s produced a 79 32 record as a starter while baltimore has gone 6 11 without him jackson has missed multiple games in three previous seasons including four last year when baltimore failed to make the playoffs huntley and the ravens 3 1 kick off against the host falcons 2 2 at 8 20 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Ravens preparing two game plans with Lamar Jackson’s status vs. Falcons up in the air
news_mentions.description: With Lamar Jackson’s status still up in the air for Sunday's game against the Falcons, OC Declan Doyle is prepping two separate game plans. One for Jackson. Another for Tyler “Snoop” Huntley.
news_mentions.body_text: lamar jackson missed his second straight day of practice on thursday while nursing the ankle injury that knocked him out of the second half of week 4 the ravens insist jackson doesn t need to practice to play but it hasn t looked great thus far with jackson s status still up in the air for sunday s game against the falcons offensive coordinator declan doyle is prepping two separate game plans one for jackson another for tyler snoop huntley you have to have this avenue of if snoop s going this is the way i wanna call it this is the direction i wanna go doyle said thursday via the baltimore sun and yet if l s going huntley has shown an ability to manage the offense when jackson has been out in the past but doesn t bring the same explosive ability as either a passer or runner if huntley starts week 5 it would be his fifth different season starting a game in place of the injured resting jackson 2021 23 2025 huntley went 2 0 in 2025 as the ravens starter first year coach jesse minter echoed doyle s thoughts on the difference in the qbs i mean look there is only one lamar jackson minter said this week i think snoop as a backup quarterback in this league and even as a starter at times has shown the ability to come in and really kind of run the offense make plays with his legs and be able to make plays on third down the ravens have gone 6 11 in games jackson has missed since his first full season as the starting qb in 2019 last week when huntley took over in the second half the ravens offense stalled out generating 116 total yards on 28 plays huntley completed eight of nine passes but mustered only 63 yards in the conservative game plan with a full week to prep a plan for huntley the hope is the ravens can find some explosives if huntley starts he has kind of got a really cool good mentality to be that guy minter said of huntley he does not really get bothered and so he keeps a pretty cool head about himself he does not feel pressure too much and to me when a guy is needed to go in there and he has that type of mentality that is what allows him to be successful whether it s jackson or huntley derrick henry should see a ton of totes even against a falcons defense that ranks no 1 against the run through four games

news_mentions.headline: Eagles trade Cam Jurgens, 2027 seventh-round pick to Ravens for '27 fifth-rounder, '28 second-rounder
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles traded center Cam Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick to the Baltimore Ravens in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round selection and a 2028 second-rounder, the teams announced Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the ravens are throwing more resources at their center conundrum baltimore has acquired cam jurgens in a trade with the philadelphia eagles sending a 2027 fifth round selection and a 2028 second round pick to philadelphia for the nebraska product the ravens are also receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in the deal the teams announced wednesday jurgens arrived to philadelphia as a second round pick in 2022 and the chosen successor to franchise legend jason kelce who assisted general manager howie roseman in the pre draft scouting process for the position and identified jurgens as his ideal replacement jurgens had to wait until kelce retired after the 2023 season to step into the first string role starting 16 games in 2024 and earning a pro bowl nod the first of two he returned to the pro bowl in 2025 despite an ideal fit and time to acclimate jurgens promise never quite matched his production he started strong ranking in the upper half among his counterparts in 2024 per pro football focus and signed a four year 68 million extension in 2025 but battled health challenges that required surgery that offseason in 2026 an injury to guard landon dickerson prompted coach nick sirianni to slide jurgens over to replace dickerson producing nightmarish results that included a second to last pff grade through four weeks jurgens wasn t the lone culprit amid philadelphia s offensive line challenges which also included right tackle lane johnson s week 4 absence and surprise retirement on tuesday the eagles willingness to part with jurgens signals they d rather move in a different direction though ending an experiment that began with promise in 2022 and fizzled by 2026 baltimore has been desperate for help at the pivot since tyler linderbaum left for las vegas in free agency veteran danny pinter began camp as linderbaum s replacement but suffered a season ending injury before the regular season began jovaughn gwyn subsequently rose to the starting role and suffered a fibula fracture that will keep him out for multiple months and a flier taken on veteran ethan pocic another experienced center coming off an injury failed to stick after pocic suffered a knee injury with all three on injured reserve the ravens needed an immediate replacement dialing philadelphia to acquire a former day 2 pick at a relatively high price in jurgens who would have an opportunity to return to center with a team that has serious super bowl aspirations he ll need to get up to speed quickly especially with the possibility that he ll be snapping to backup quarterback tyler huntley in the coming weeks following lamar jackson s ankle injury suffered in week 4 jurgens self reported concussion symptoms on monday and is in concussion protocol ahead of baltimore s week 5 game against the falcons

jackson was ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to the bills los angeles rams cornerback jaylen watson shoulder was ruled out shortly after halftime against the broncos tight end terrance ferguson aggravated an ankle injury sunday night head coach sean mcvay had no updates on watson or ferguson after the game miami dolphins running back de 39 von achane knee was ruled out from sunday s loss to the chiefs dolphins head coach jeff hafley told reporters after the game that achane s injury did not sound optimistic per espn com minnesota vikings receiver sunday s loss to the raiders new york giants pass rusher brian burns knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans new york jets running back breece hall thigh and offensive lineman dylan parham knee were ruled out from sunday s loss to the lions tampa bay buccaneers quarterback baker mayfield dislocated his right thumb in the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to the vikings and will undergo an mri on monday head coach todd bowles said jalen mcmillan knee was ruled out tennessee titans guard fernando carmona ankle was ruled out from sunday s loss to the giants san francisco 49ers wide receiver mike evans is dealing with a rib strain and will have a full evaluation monday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported evans was injured in the second quarter of sunday s win over the cardinals and ruled out after halftime offensive tackle trent williams stinger and linebacker dre greenlaw quad did not return washington commanders linebacker leo chenal was ruled out after suffering a neck injury during sunday s win over the seahawks chenal was carted off the field on a stretcher in the second quarter guard lucas patrick ankle did not return

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage
