news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Eagles trade Cam Jurgens, 2027 seventh-round pick to Ravens for '27 fifth-rounder, '28 second-rounder
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles traded center Cam Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick to the Baltimore Ravens in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round selection and a 2028 second-rounder, the teams announced Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the ravens are throwing more resources at their center conundrum baltimore has acquired cam jurgens in a trade with the philadelphia eagles sending a 2027 fifth round selection and a 2028 second round pick to philadelphia for the nebraska product the ravens are also receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in the deal the teams announced wednesday jurgens arrived to philadelphia as a second round pick in 2022 and the chosen successor to franchise legend jason kelce who assisted general manager howie roseman in the pre draft scouting process for the position and identified jurgens as his ideal replacement jurgens had to wait until kelce retired after the 2023 season to step into the first string role starting 16 games in 2024 and earning a pro bowl nod the first of two he returned to the pro bowl in 2025 despite an ideal fit and time to acclimate jurgens promise never quite matched his production he started strong ranking in the upper half among his counterparts in 2024 per pro football focus and signed a four year 68 million extension in 2025 but battled health challenges that required surgery that offseason in 2026 an injury to guard landon dickerson prompted coach nick sirianni to slide jurgens over to replace dickerson producing nightmarish results that included a second to last pff grade through four weeks jurgens wasn t the lone culprit amid philadelphia s offensive line challenges which also included right tackle lane johnson s week 4 absence and surprise retirement on tuesday the eagles willingness to part with jurgens signals they d rather move in a different direction though ending an experiment that began with promise in 2022 and fizzled by 2026 baltimore has been desperate for help at the pivot since tyler linderbaum left for las vegas in free agency veteran danny pinter began camp as linderbaum s replacement but suffered a season ending injury before the regular season began jovaughn gwyn subsequently rose to the starting role and suffered a fibula fracture that will keep him out for multiple months and a flier taken on veteran ethan pocic another experienced center coming off an injury failed to stick after pocic suffered a knee injury with all three on injured reserve the ravens needed an immediate replacement dialing philadelphia to acquire a former day 2 pick at a relatively high price in jurgens who would have an opportunity to return to center with a team that has serious super bowl aspirations he ll need to get up to speed quickly especially with the possibility that he ll be snapping to backup quarterback tyler huntley in the coming weeks following lamar jackson s ankle injury suffered in week 4 jurgens self reported concussion symptoms on monday and is in concussion protocol ahead of baltimore s week 5 game against the falcons

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: Who takes the latest installment of the heated 49ers-Seahawks rivalry? Will the Patriots' resurgence continue against the upstart Raiders? Can the Bills get back on track by knocking off the Rams on Monday night? Check out the Week 5 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 5 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 30 p m et on thursday oct 8 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 11 why jeremy picked the jaguars the eagles are flying into london battered bruised and beleaguered lane johnson retired and cam jurgens traded are no longer with the team while saquon barkley and myriad other starters are nursing injuries that s not how you want to show up against the jaguars who are bullying the competition so far jacksonville hasn t allowed over 20 points in a game through four weeks and is playing remarkably consistent offensive ball league low four three and outs while duval does the london trip every year and will be staying an extra week this season philly hasn t played in the u k under nick sirianni the midseason voyage couldn t come at a worse time for coach and club why gennaro picked the bengals we need to talk about joe burrow cincinnati has a problem with the quarterback and surprisingly it has nothing to do with his health rather it s the backbreaking turnovers he s committed in consecutive losses after successfully surging out of the gates with a pair of wins the bengals have dropped to 500 with burrow s fourth quarter blunders both of which occurred on first down in plus territory it s quite unexpected to see joe brrr freeze up at winning time or is it the late flubs in the past fortnight have rekindled a debate in cincy about whether or not burrow is clutch with doubters dusting off an infamous statistic that burrow is now 1 35 when trailing at any point in the final eight minutes of a game put me in the camp of those who dismiss this figure as noisy data i believe in joe s clutch gene but i m not entirely bullish on the current state of his offense the bengals have been unable to get the run game going this year and now the aerial attack s in limbo with ja marr chase concussion and tee higgins groin neck dealing with injuries cincinnati should still be able to handle winless miami but the contest could be closer than you expect why gennaro picked the patriots a week ago it felt like drake maye carried the weight of the world on his shoulders the 24 year old responded admirably playing his best game of the season to lead the patriots to a road upset of the previously unbeaten rival bills meanwhile in las vegas the raiders entered last week with a surprising 3 0 record that some attributed to underwhelming competition how would the silver and black fare against the big bad resurgent chiefs pretty well kirk cousins actually outdueled patrick mahomes but kenneth walker ultimately proved to be too much for the home team lifting kansas city to a hard fought rivalry win so are the patriots back are the raiders for real i answer both questions with a definitive maybe look all of us teams and analysts alike are still feeling out this young season at this point both sides give reason to believe while also leaving room for doubt but the most established unit in this game is new england s defense combine that with my lingering skepticism of this kirko chainz renaissance and the fact that vegas run game has largely stalled since ashton jeanty s wondrous week 1 and i ll ride with the home team in a low scoring affair why brooke picked the vikings minnesota has got to find some offense because field goals aren t going to cut it every week despite how poor that unit has been the vikings have the edge against the saints defense in overall passing and rushing efficiency per nfl pro veteran aaron jones has been a boon averaging 108 3 scrimmage yards per game since jordan mason was placed on ir after week 1 while kyler murray slowly finds his footing getting justin jefferson ankle back would certainly help murray in that process the saints underwhelmed on all fronts against the falcons giving up a 40 burger and struggling offensively things won t get easier for kellen moore and tyler shough brian flores defense has blitzed on 70 5 of dropbacks this season and generated a 46 8 pressure rate both the highest marks since 2018 per ngs shough has recorded 5 7 yards per attempt against the blitz seventh lowest in the nfl and 8 1 yards per attempt against pressure third highest most notably he hasn t faced a blitz rate above 38 5 of his dropbacks in any game he has started in his career the second year qb faces an uphill climb and it doesn t help that alvin kamara s dealing with a back injury it certainly feels like minnesota has been playing with fire eking out weird wins by the week but consider this another good timing matchup with a foe that s searching for some answers on multiple fronts the vikings improve to 5 0 heading into the bye week why bobby picked the browns it s time to admit the browns might have something cooking they ve now won three straight after an embarrassing loss to the jaguars to begin the season two of the three opponents that have fallen to them the buccaneers and steelers have some big question marks but cleveland is the only team thus far to have silenced the panthers offense in any way plus bad teams don t typically rattle off three victories in a row no matter how the schedule looks deshaun watson has completed at least 72 percent of his passes in three of four contests buoyed by a trio of young pass catchers who have helped change the offense s trajectory denzel boston kc concepcion and harold fannin the mason graham injury absolutely hurts cleveland s defensive outlook but the unit is performing well enough to contain the jets who just played one of the most confounding games in recent memory the 23 12 scoreline of new york s week 4 loss to the bears doesn t come close to telling the full story gang green lost the time of possession battle 17 15 to 42 45 and managed only seven first downs to chicago s 34 notably two more first downs than the amount of plays 32 the jets even ran kudos to the bears but it s difficult to back a team coming off a performance like that and mired in a three game losing streak count on the browns to move to 4 1 for the first time since 2020 why jeremy picked the steelers pittsburgh is going through it the steelers have stewed for a week after their tnf loss to cleveland in which every veteran seemed to have lost his temper by sunday heads should be cooler just as jonathan taylor is heating up the colts star rb carried his team to victory in london and is finding the end zone at a near league best clip if taylor can dictate sunday s game indy will come away with it daniel jones may be standing in the way a turnover machine in the past few weeks jones faces an opportunistic pittsburgh defense in week 5 one that has logged two takeaways in each of its first four games indianapolis hasn t won a game s turnover battle since november 2025 for two teams on the edge of the postseason discussion in the afc sunday s result could be critical down the line whoever takes care of the ball should come out ahead point pittsburgh why gennaro picked the texans seeing how tennessee has finished each of the last two seasons with a league low three wins nobody s too surprised the titans are 0 4 but the texans remaining winless in mid october that s utterly shocking especially with c j stroud playing his best football since his transcendent rookie campaign in 2023 houston s defense which entered this season with great expectations to be the league s preeminent stopping unit has fallen flat not only do the texans rank in the 20s in total defense scoring d epa play and a host of additional metrics but they can t close houston has held a lead in the final two minutes of three of its four losses the talent rich defense just cannot get that final stop it s truly confounding given the retention from last season s top ranked group with the texans season reaching a state of emergency head coach demeco ryans broke glass taking over defensive play calling duties for this week s divisional game i think this leads to a spirited effort against the league s last ranked total offense if houston can t get off the schneid against the only team that s yet to produce 300 yards in a game this season the texans are broken beyond repair why jeremy picked the commanders new york narrowly escaped a home loss to the cardinals last week surviving the full jameis winston experience with a field flipping pick six on the last play of the game the first place giants haven t played up to their 3 1 record so far this season against the 1 3 commanders the sides should even out washington is returning its star qb jayden daniels from a dislocated left elbow after it was forced to play athan kaliakmanis for the bulk of its international effort the commanders have a laundry list of injuries but daronte jones blitz happy front figures to give jameis winston fits with whoever takes the field washington s revamped o line will face a real test with new york s defensive front led by abdul carter and droy candidate arvell reese but the commanders have fared well against the giants in all forms since dan quinn took over 4 0 and should continue to do so sunday why dan picked the bears i need to see a defense slow down ben johnson s running game before i pick against the bears the sample size is still small in 2026 but chicago s 196 3 rush yards per game are the second most by any team in the last 40 seasons 2019 ravens 206 0 per nfl research the packers rank 28th against the run and they just lost one of their best players linebacker edgerrin cooper to a season ending achilles tear the contrast here is stark green bay averages 58 rush yards per game the fewest in the league it seems well within the realm of possibility that the bears absolutely dominate in time of possession for the third straight week if caleb williams fill in tyson bagent is mistake prone in his second start of the year the cheeseheads could feast he s going to see his share of pressures the packers blitz at the eighth highest rate in the league 39 3 but i m expecting the ground game to provide him another relatively stress free day why bobby picked the broncos a lot of the elements that could ve rendered this a precarious matchup for the broncos are balanced out by the chargers dealing with similar issues denver has scored only 13 first half points through four games requiring a pair of comebacks from double digit deficits just to be sitting at 2 2 unless sean payton taking over play calling from first year offensive coordinator davis webb drastically changes those early game woes the broncos will remain vulnerable to opponents jumping out to sizeable leads luckily for denver the chargers haven t proven to be capable of doing that thus far they only cracked the 20 point mark for the first time last week the broncos could also be without their two top cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss rib but los angeles will be dealing with absences at both offensive tackle spots joe alt neck and rashawn slater ankle are both set to miss the contest as long as denver manufactures pressure against justin herbert who has experienced a nightmare start to the campaign the defense should be able to make life easier on its corners stepping into expanded roles with this being a divisional matchup the result could still end up closer than the records and general vibes suggest but that s technically another point in the broncos favor they tend to wake up and thrive in the clutch why brooke picked the lions after a hot start in week 1 the cardinals certainly have cooled off they have allowed at least 30 points in each of their last three games fortunately one of the three teams allowing more points per game this season is this week s opponent the lions who have scored and allowed 24 plus points in all four games simply put expect plenty of offense and fantasy points in this one the lions pick your poison unit with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown jameson williams and sam laporta in tow should have no problem rebounding from last week s roller coaster loss in carolina jacoby brissett has done some good things too notably when targeting trey mcbride and michael wilson the cardinals must find the end zone to stay with the ever explosive lions but a few too many field goals by the home team will likely put them on the losing end why dan picked the seahawks i still believe in the seahawks defense even after some rough moments in the past couple weeks seattle still has allowed the fewest total yards per game 246 8 yards per play 4 0 and pass yards per game 144 8 while also tying for the most interceptions 6 in the league 49ers qb brock purdy is rightfully one of the top mvp candidates through week 4 the man hasn t been sacked yet but can he keep it going at lumen field he had just two touchdown passes four interceptions and a 72 5 passer rating in his three games against seattle last season the seahawks were the only 49ers opponent to stop purdy from throwing a td pass in 2025 and they did it twice in week 18 and in the divisional round there s no guarantee history will repeat itself and the seahawks are not operating like the finely tuned machine they were toward the end of last season it s probably going to take forcing a sam darnold error or two for san francisco to win but i m not banking on the team with the league s seventh lowest pressure rate 31 6 to discombobulate him why brooke picked the falcons is anyone better in prime time than bijan robinson not in my book though derrick henry might have something to say about that but god bless the schedule makers for giving us bijan thrice in night games over the first five weeks in atlanta s last two games road routs of green bay and new orleans he has rushed for 339 yards and four scores it feels like there s no stopping bijan at this juncture i expect a heavy dose of the run game from two of the league s top rushing attacks especially if lamar jackson doesn t suit up the two time mvp has an outside chance to play sunday night after sustaining an ankle injury in baltimore s last game if he can t go tyler huntley would make his first start of the season he s proven to be a capable backup winning both of his starts for the ravens in 2025 but will he do enough in the pass game to keep atlanta s defense from solely keying on henry stepping in for jackson in the second half last week huntley attempted only one pass of 10 or more air yards while three were short throws 0 9 yards and five occurred behind the line of scrimmage not sure that ll get the job done against a falcons offense that s scored with ease with michael penix under center if jackson is healthy and plays this becomes much harder to predict yet it s hard to go against these falcons right now editor s update ravens coach jesse minter announced on friday that lamar jackson has been ruled out of sunday s game extra note sunday would mark falcons left tackle jake matthews 200th consecutive start the longtime veteran exited monday night s game with a groin injury leaving the nfl s longest active consecutive starts streak in jeopardy this type of longevity is extremely rare and it ll be a real shame if he falls just short of such a milestone number monday oct 12 why dan picked the rams we saw last week that the bills have a get right defense for quarterbacks with buffalo allowing drake maye to have his best game of the season by far after a horrendous start to 2026 i m counting on matthew stafford to shake off his struggles 6 6 td int ratio against a defense that doesn t appear up to the challenge of covering puka nacua and davante adams the bills rank among the bottom 10 in scoring and total defense while los angeles ranks among the top 10 in both categories now if the rams keep trying to beat themselves with turnovers and poor special teams play we know josh allen will make them pay l a needed a fourth quarter rally to beat the eagles last week despite outgaining them 415 172 sean mcvay is too good a coach to have his team playing sloppy football for long though i don t like being in the position of picking against allen even though he has four giveaways in the last two games 3 ints 1 fumble lost but the rams look like the more well rounded squad at the moment thursday s game why bobby picked the cowboys defensive issues continue to plague dallas but the buccaneers don t have enough firepower to keep up with dak prescott and co regardless tampa bay is the only team this season that has amassed fewer than 200 net passing yards and 150 net rushing yards in every game heading into week 5 per nfl research just take a look at ceedee lamb versus the entire bucs wr corps lamb who collected 17 receptions for 189 yards and a touchdown in the cowboys 34 30 win over the texans now has 37 receptions 498 receiving yards 28 receiving first downs and four td catches chris godwin emeka egbuka ted hurst tez johnson and kameron johnson have combined for 44 receptions 501 receiving yards 22 receiving first downs and two td catches sure tampa bay could presumably home in on limiting lamb but that still leaves threats like george pickens jake ferguson and javonte williams to deal with home field advantage and history is also on dallas side as jalon daniels prepares for his second career start only one undrafted rookie qb in nfl history has ever started and recorded a win over the cowboys washington s ed rubbert during the 1987 strike that washington squad of replacement news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 4 games: Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) exit
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 4 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 4 sunday arizona cardinals safety andrew wingard knee and guard isaiah adams ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the giants tight end hunter long knee did not return offensive tackle paris johnson suffered a biceps injury and was wearing a sling in the locker room following the game per espn baltimore ravens cornerback marlon humphrey calf was ruled out of sunday s win over the titans quarterback lamar jackson ankle did not return buffalo bills wide receiver dj moore aggravated his shoulder injury in sunday s loss to the patriots but it is not currently considered a long term issue espn s adam schefter reported defensive back te 39 cory couch hamstring defensive lineman ed oliver knee and cornerback dee alford ankle did not return carolina panthers offensive tacklemonroe freeling knee was injured in the third quarter and later ruled out chicago bears running back kyle monangai injured his thumb in sunday s win over the jets head coach ben johnson said cincinnati bengals wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was ruled out after he suffered a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to the jaguars denver broncos cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss ribs were ruled out of sunday s loss to the 49ers wide receiver pat bryant ankle was carted to the locker room in the third quarter and did not return head coach sean payton did not have any injury updates following the game detroit lions cornerback rock ya sin left sunday night s game with a hamstring injury green bay packers linebacker edgerrin cooper achilles was ruled out of sunday s win over tampa bay head coach matt lafleur told reporters after the game that he suspects that cooper will miss the remainder of the season cornerback brandon cisse neck did not return and was evaluated for a concussion houston texans cornerback jaylin smith hamstring was ruled out of sunday s loss to dallas jacksonville jaguars safety caleb ransaw knee did not return to sunday s win over the bengals kansas city chiefs wide receiver rashee rice hamstring was injured in the first quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the raiders head coach andy reid described rice s injury as a tweak wide receiver tyquan thornton who was carted off the field during sunday s game suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday night thornton will undergo a full evaluation monday morning and is out indefinitely las vegas raiders wide receiver jalen nailor concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the chiefs los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey foot and offensive tackle joe alt neck were ruled out of sunday s loss to the seahawks offensive tackle rashawn slater ankle and cornerback donte jackson hamstring did not return los angeles rams wide receiver konata mumpfield shoulder did not return to sunday s win over philadelphia return to sunday s win over the bills new york giants wide receiver braxton berrios foot defensive lineman chauncey golston and safety jason pinnock were ruled out of sunday s win over arizona new york jets defensive end braiden mcgregor chest was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago philadelphia eagles running back saquon barkley hamstring was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the rams linebacker jonathan greenard ankle was ruled out in the second half cornerback quinyon mitchell knee did not return following the loss head coach nick sirianni would not expand on right tackle lane johnson being inactive due to personal reasons telling reporters he s dealing with a personal matter and that s all i m going to say on that san francisco 49ers fullback kyle juszczyk knee is believed to be dealing with a sprain after he was ruled out of sunday s win over the broncos head coach kyle shanahan said jusczcyk will undergo more testing monday per shanahan cornerback upton stout shoulder will undergo testing monday per shanahan seattle seahawks defensive tackle leonard williams left in the middle of the fourth quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the chargers head coach mike macdonald told reporters postgame that the team will have to see about williams but his injury does not appear serious tampa bay buccaneers linebacker sirvocea dennis ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the packers washington commanders quarterback marcus mariota knee defensive end charles omenihu groin and wide receiver jaylin lane ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer
