news_mentions.headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) out vs. Falcons; Tyler Huntley to start
news_mentions.description: There was reportedly an outside chance Lamar Jackson could play in Week 5. Now there's zero chance as Jackson has been ruled out ahead of the Ravens' game against the Falcons on Sunday night.
news_mentions.body_text: there was reportedly an outside chance lamar jackson could play in week 5 now there s zero chance as jackson has been ruled out ahead of the baltimore ravens game against the atlanta falcons on sunday night head coach jesse minter announced on friday tyler huntley will start in place of jackson minter also ruled out defensive end trey hendrickson for week 5 due to a finger injury jackson injured his ankle during the ravens week 4 win over the tennessee titans on monday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported jackson did not sustain a long term injury but the chance of him playing versus the falcons was slim with the two time ap nfl mvp being a non participant at practice throughout the week jackson s designation is hardly unexpected just how much time he ll miss will now be the prevailing question first though huntley will take the reins against a red hot falcons team it s hardly an unfamiliar situation for snoop who will make his 12th start for baltimore huntley is in his sixth season with the ravens and his second stint having played with the club from 2020 23 and rejoining them in 2025 after a year with the miami dolphins huntley is 7 9 in his career as a starter 5 6 with the ravens and 2 3 for the fins in relief of jackson against the titans huntley was 8 of 9 for 63 yards since jackson took over as the club s starter in week 11 of the 2018 season he s produced a 79 32 record as a starter while baltimore has gone 6 11 without him jackson has missed multiple games in three previous seasons including four last year when baltimore failed to make the playoffs huntley and the ravens 3 1 kick off against the host falcons 2 2 at 8 20 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) to start Sunday vs. Giants after missing two games
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will start for Washington against the visiting New York Giants on Sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow, coach Dan Quinn confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels is returning and not a moment to soon for his washington commanders daniels will start for washington against the visiting new york giants on sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow coach dan quinn confirmed friday quinn added that receiver stefon diggs hamstring won t be available for daniels in his return while terry mclaurin hamstring looked good in his return to practice friday anticipation for a potential daniels comeback came prior to washington s week 4 game in london against the indianapolis colts when he made the transatlantic flight with the team ultimately daniels was ruled out and his backup marcus mariota was injured in the defeat which dropped washington to 1 3 daniels who dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys practiced fully on wednesday and thursday a good indicator he d return sunday when he ll be backed up by seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis kaliakmanis made his impromptu debut in relief of mariota against the colts now daniels the ap nfl offensive rookie of the year in 2024 will be looked on to reverse course for washington which is coming off a disastrous 5 12 2025 that seems to be bleeding into 2026 daniels has missed 12 of the commanders last 21 games over two games this season he has largely underwhelmed completing 29 of 51 passes 56 9 for 260 yards and three touchdowns with 100 yards on 12 carries in a pair of defeats since joining the franchise as the no 2 overall selection of the 2024 nfl draft daniels is 14 12 as a starter the overwhelming majority of those wins came during his 12 4 rookie campaign that 24 season in which washington advanced to the nfc championship game seems like a lifetime ago now but the commanders have gone 4 8 without daniels in the past two years thus his return is a very welcomed one with further hope that he ll return to past phenomenal form against the first place giants 3 1

news_mentions.headline: Kelvin Sheppard on Lions' NFL-worst defense: 'Something has to change'
news_mentions.description: Detroit defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard isn’t keen on talking his way off the hot seat. He’d rather his players show it on the field.
news_mentions.body_text: detroit lions defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard isn t keen on talking his way off the hot seat he d rather his players show it on the field because at this point all of it is lip service sheppard said on thursday via mlive until it starts to show on sunday until the evidence starts to show up at the game it s lip service what we do here bridging it to the game it sounds good but it s lip service so what i will say is we did not play well enough defensively to help this team win that football game sunday night at carolina sheppard s defense has been horrific through four games the lions own the second worst scoring defense 31 8 ppg in the nfl and have allowed a league high 423 8 total yards per game the most ypg allowed by any team in a season since the 2012 saints 440 1 detroit has allowed a touchdown on 40 5 of its opponents possessions in 2026 the highest rate allowed by any team in a season since at least 2000 per nfl research there has to be real change sheppard told reporters there has to be real evidence of change whether that s personnel driven whether that s some things whatever the case is something has to change because coming out of training camp this is far from where we thought we would be at and should be at and i still do standing here before you after a four game sample size so these things will get corrected but within doing all that during doom and gloom it s easy to point at everybody but also within this let s go let s go because i do feel like we re right there at this wall right now and banging on this wall and i said there s gonna be a group of men that bust this m f er down and some guys are probably gonna be with us and some aren t detroit s defensive front has actually been good early this season the lions rank second in the nfl with 75 qb pressures aidan hutchinson sits second in the league with 28 qbp and alim mcneill s 15 ranks tied for fourth among defensive tackles the defensive front has caused havoc the back seven has been a mess the linebackers look lost the secondary is a particularly decrepit brand of ineptitude sheppard knows the issue isn t with the front i told the d line it s a disservice what we ve been doing to you all sheppard said i truly feel like this is the best d line we ve had in my six year tenure here since i got here in 2021 and we haven t been complementing it well enough on the back end to see the results of it and be outright beneficiaries the pressure is ramping up for sheppard despite coach dan campbell dismissing the idea of moving on from the second year defensive coordinator sheppard was put in a tough spot with brad holmes lack of high level additions to the secondary in the offseason a db crew that was clearly lacking in the summer is already on fumes after four weeks praying brian branch returns from an achilles injury and doesn t miss a beat sheppard s lions 2 2 take on the cardinals 1 3 in arizona on sunday at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Ravens preparing two game plans with Lamar Jackson’s status vs. Falcons up in the air
news_mentions.description: With Lamar Jackson’s status still up in the air for Sunday's game against the Falcons, OC Declan Doyle is prepping two separate game plans. One for Jackson. Another for Tyler “Snoop” Huntley.
news_mentions.body_text: lamar jackson missed his second straight day of practice on thursday while nursing the ankle injury that knocked him out of the second half of week 4 the ravens insist jackson doesn t need to practice to play but it hasn t looked great thus far with jackson s status still up in the air for sunday s game against the falcons offensive coordinator declan doyle is prepping two separate game plans one for jackson another for tyler snoop huntley you have to have this avenue of if snoop s going this is the way i wanna call it this is the direction i wanna go doyle said thursday via the baltimore sun and yet if l s going huntley has shown an ability to manage the offense when jackson has been out in the past but doesn t bring the same explosive ability as either a passer or runner if huntley starts week 5 it would be his fifth different season starting a game in place of the injured resting jackson 2021 23 2025 huntley went 2 0 in 2025 as the ravens starter first year coach jesse minter echoed doyle s thoughts on the difference in the qbs i mean look there is only one lamar jackson minter said this week i think snoop as a backup quarterback in this league and even as a starter at times has shown the ability to come in and really kind of run the offense make plays with his legs and be able to make plays on third down the ravens have gone 6 11 in games jackson has missed since his first full season as the starting qb in 2019 last week when huntley took over in the second half the ravens offense stalled out generating 116 total yards on 28 plays huntley completed eight of nine passes but mustered only 63 yards in the conservative game plan with a full week to prep a plan for huntley the hope is the ravens can find some explosives if huntley starts he has kind of got a really cool good mentality to be that guy minter said of huntley he does not really get bothered and so he keeps a pretty cool head about himself he does not feel pressure too much and to me when a guy is needed to go in there and he has that type of mentality that is what allows him to be successful whether it s jackson or huntley derrick henry should see a ton of totes even against a falcons defense that ranks no 1 against the run through four games

news_mentions.headline: Jerry Jones 'extraordinarily disappointed' after Cowboys loss to Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: The Dallas Cowboys lost 24-16 to the previously winless Tampa Bay Buccaneers, falling to 2-3 to start the season.
news_mentions.body_text: the dallas cowboys laid a large egg on thursday night losing 24 16 to the tampa bay buccaneers extraordinarily extraordinarily disappointed owner jerry jones said of the loss via the team s official website you really do need to get it done when it s there to take they basically were very physical i thought both their fronts was really surprised at how well they ran the ball how they ran it between the tackles that was surprising we thought if they were going to run it they d do it outside and thought we d put it on the quarterback s shoulders their staff their quarterback all their players got a great victory here tonight and it was a tough loss for us it wasn t just that the cowboys lost to the previously winless bucs and undrafted rookie quarterback jalon daniels who played with savvy and fortitude in his first road start from dallas perspective the disappointing part was the unforced errors the seemingly lackadaisical scattered offense the inability to get a stop on defense and to top off the excrement pie a special teams kickoff fumble that led directly to a 14 point deficit the cowboys were lucky to be up 10 7 at halftime then watched that lead deteriorate in less than a quarter dallas opened the half unable to tackle bucky irving did his best barry sanders impression taking the first play of the second half 72 yards to set up a tampa td dak prescott then threw an int in a tight window that clanged off ryan flournoy s hands the cowboys defense again let the bucs walk down the field for a score on the ensuing kickoff kavontae turpin fumbled boy i ve been so disappointed before with losses but this was disappointing jones said and i m disappointed because i see potential growth here and we need to have good experiences on an individual basis as well as a team and this was not a good experience out here throughout the contest todd bowles defense had prescott in the spin cycle the qb rarely looked comfortable was uncharacteristically off the mark on numerous passes and couldn t get things going until late when dallas was already down two scores the final interception flew through jake ferguson s hands it was an overwhelming disappointment for dallas the defense remains a sore spot daron bland has been bad to open the season allowing 91 yards on three catches thursday the cowboys defense couldn t slow tampa s offense in the second half or stop irving even with a shot to get the ball back late after the int the cowboys let irving scamper for 22 yards to seal the loss the defense was bad again this time the offense couldn t overcome it and special teams chipped in with a turnover after the game fans frustration boiled over when a driver for a contracted car service yelled out embarrassing as prescott walked past leading to an exchange between the two that prescott took exception to per the team s official website the qb was more upset with the person than the opinion i know when he said it i just happened to look at him and at that point you know he looked away and then when i turned my head back he said something else prescott explained and so that s the part that as a man feel free to speak your mind but speak it and don t cower away from the reaction that you re going to get so if you re saying it s embarrassing say it s embarrassing if you re saying it to me then say it to me you know what i mean don t go back on it so that s all that was and i hate that it s even being talked about to be honest with you prescott acknowledged the cowboys didn t play well but he said calling it embarrassing would belittle bowles and the bucs to use the word embarrassing it s tough prescott said i feel like i m discrediting the nfl if i use that and particularly the tampa bay bucs the great todd bowles a coach and defensive coached team the guy s been a winning coach for a long time whether he s been a head coach or a defensive coordinator that s the plan and what they did tonight is the reason for that to say embarrassing i think i d be discrediting them but we were definitely supposed to win this game that we re supposed to have on paper or whichever way you want to look at it i think schotty said it best in the locker room in this league you ve got to win the games you re supposed to win when a winless team comes into your home stadium on a thursday night prime time game yeah we re supposed to win that it sucks and right up there close to embarrassing but i don t know if i would say that whatever word you want to use for the cowboys night everyone can agree it was an ugly mess and perhaps the worst loss of brian schottenheimer s tenure

news_mentions.headline: Broncos' Sean Payton takes over offensive play-calling duties after slow start for Bo Nix and Co.
news_mentions.description: Broncos coach Sean Payton confirmed Thursday that he will take over offensive play-calling duties from first-year coordinator Davis Webb.
news_mentions.body_text: denver broncos coach sean payton confirmed thursday that he will take over offensive play calling duties from first year coordinator davis webb we ll make a change offensively payton told reporters i ll call the plays i ve done this long enough where i know when i have a future head coach and webb s gonna be one all the things that it s hard to find will happen in fact the same thing to some degree a little bit different happened to myself earlier in my career nfl network and espn reported earlier thursday that payton would be more heavily involved in play calling in week 5 against los angeles the coach s announcement later thursday was more definitive payton said he made the decision on monday and added that webb will still be involved in game planning and be with the coach on the sideline during games webb was elevated to oc this offseason after serving the last three seasons as quarterbacks coach adding offensive pass game coordinator to his title in 2025 the hope is that payton calling plays will unlock what bo nix does best make plays often out of structure after four weeks of low ceiling offensive showings i think collectively when you re playing well on offense you re doing a lot of little things well and then that job for him becomes somewhat easier payton said earlier this week via the denver post so that s really the focus this week is the little things detailing the little things and we ll see that in the end product nix s statistics aren t horrid by any means he s completed 60 percent of his passes for 819 yards and a 5 3 td int ratio through four games good for a passer rating of 80 4 but those numbers paint a picture of an average quarterback and are on track to finish as career lows for nix denver didn t build this offense around nix for him to simply be average for us obviously it s all about winning it s all about putting our team in the best situation possible nix said so for me there are definitely several things that i want to change and i want to get better at that s going to happen it s going to come over time if broncos fans have a gripe with nix it s likely that he s playing too safely nix became a checkdown master in week 4 posting an air yards per attempt mark of 4 6 of his 42 passing attempts 29 targeted pass catchers behind the line of scrimmage or short of 10 yards downfield he s also taking off for scrambles less often minimizing a running threat that has propelled him to success early in his nfl career i think because i m seeing the field better and i know where my outlets are and i m getting to them faster nix said when asked why he s scrambling less i think that s just a product of being in the system for three years and understanding i ll ask you all do you all want me with the ball or rj harvey with the ball well that s not fair to harvey the running back put in yeoman s work sunday catching a career high 10 passes for 68 yards while handling seven carries for 25 yards denver having a running back lead the team in targets by a wide margin in its 24 14 loss to the 49ers highlights one of the problems with its offense it s not that nix needs to take unnecessary risks but the broncos feature too much talent for nix to constantly take checkdowns perhaps that s what payton has seen in his four weeks spent as a head coach without play calling power it s time to take this offense off the leash we ll see how payton taking control of play calling affects nix s performance against the chargers on sunday broncos fans sure will hope it produces more of the magic from last season we re 2 2 payton said thursday but we feel like there s more there

news_mentions.headline: Patriots' Efton Chism takes high road in response to Bills DB C.J. Gardner-Johnson's trash talk
news_mentions.description: Following the Patriots' victory over the Bills, Buffalo defensive back C.J. Gardner-Johnson derided New England's Efton Chism as a practice-squad player who won't be heard from again. Chism has since responded in the typical Patriot Way.
news_mentions.body_text: efton chism s big day irked bills safety c j gardner johnson who is never one to bite his tongue after the patriots 29 26 win over the bills a bitter gardner johnson erroneously derided the former undrafted free agent receiver whose big plays including a one handed go ahead touchdown grab late propelled the patriots to an upset victory over the bills as a practice squad player whom new england elevated and probably won t hear from again chism who has never spent time on new england s practice squad took the high road in typical patriots fashion he s a great player chism said of gardner johnson via boston com they re a great team i ve got a bunch of respect for him but we re excited for this week looking forward to the raiders bill belichick may have departed but mike vrabel s tenure has preserved some of the proper public approaches that were cornerstones of the patriot way while chism is in only his second season he s clearly caught on and isn t interested in testing his own luck by engaging in useless banter with one of the league s best trash talkers instead he s focusing on building on his banner day and carving out a role that will last beyond this temporary period in which there s room for lesser known players while a j brown is sidelined you love to see players take advantage of opportunities and help the team win vrabel said he is very well respected he practices he does the show team and takes a million reps nobody logs more miles or yards or whatever we track than chism as a former player who reached the mountaintop three times while wearing the patriots uniform vrabel appreciates a maximum effort player who demonstrates a hunger to improve and the ability to capitalize when his number is called that s exponentially more valuable than some bitter postgame chatter

news_mentions.headline: Cam Heyward won't 'apologize' for sideline outburst in Steelers' loss to Browns
news_mentions.description: The Steelers' Week 4 loss might feel like it happened weeks ago at this point, but their veterans are still answering questions for their demonstrative conduct during the defeat in Cleveland.
news_mentions.body_text: the pittsburgh steelers thursday night loss might feel like it happened weeks ago at this point but their veterans are still answering questions for their demonstrative conduct during the week 4 defeat in cleveland with an extended period between one game and the next there isn t much more to discuss plus when cam heyward joins the outbursts that are usually reserved for aaron rodgers and coach mike mccarthy it s a concerning sign mccarthy downplayed the choice words he used in reaction to rodgers angrily demanding he relay the play quicker telling reporters i don t want to be saying those type of words heyward on the other hand thought the steelers frustrated expressions were just fine we ve always had emotion heyward said this week via the pittsburgh post gazette i don t think that s anything to shy away from i ve always been someone who tends to get a little feisty on the sideline i m not going to apologize for that that s part of the game we hold ourselves to a high standard we expect a lot out of our group when we don t we re pissed off because of it the caught on camera expressions weren t limited to that trio either steelers legend t j watt was also seen engaging in an especially animated interaction with defensive coordinator patrick graham over a sideline headset and prime video s production crew eagerly included a shot of heyward shouting at his teammates amid their defensive struggles to demonstrate how frustrated the steelers were with their performance against their afc north rivals the frustration was justified against a browns offensive line featuring two inexperienced replacements in center luke wypler and rookie guard austin barber the steelers defensive front typically one of the most productive and relentless in the nfl failed to make a difference leaving plenty of room for deshaun watson to power a 21 point second quarter that sent the browns into the break with a 21 10 lead there was a lot bothering me in that game heyward said i just didn t like the way the game was trending there was a multitude of things you can go back to any team and see there are times when it takes some of your leaders just getting a little more pissed off and we shouldn t apologize for that we should embrace it in our game and we should move on and find how we can get better as a veteran leader heyward has earned the respect and influence to criticize his teammates when warranted he saw what was happening in real time and tried his best to correct their mistakes before it was too late it didn t quite work out cleveland held on to win 27 24 with the steelers only one month into the season heyward feels now is a better time than ever for pittsburgh s players to be direct with each other in an effort to collectively improve i think with our group we re able to have hard conversations anywhere he said we don t have very sensitive guys on our team we can be who we want to be and challenge each other that s how it should be your brother should hold you accountable when you re trying to reach something and be the best in the world it s up to your guys to be honest with each other when it s uncomfortable if heyward is right the steelers will fix their issues and won t allow future opponents starting with indianapolis in week 5 to enjoy nearly as much success in the weeks ahead even if it goes against the conventional standard mccarthy to which is holding himself we can guarantee rodgers won t hold back anytime soon

news_mentions.headline: DeMeco Ryans taking over defensive play-calling duties from DC Matt Burke amid Texans' 0-4 start
news_mentions.description: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans announced on Wednesday he is assuming defensive play-calling duties from coordinator Matt Burke following an 0-4 start to the season.
news_mentions.body_text: houston texans head coach demeco ryans has had enough of his team s defensive struggles and is making a change after an 0 4 start to the 2026 season fueled in part by the 20th ranked unit ryans said on wednesday he will take over defensive play calling duties from coordinator matt burke if there s a lack in communication i look at myself first so it starts with me and making sure i m a better communicator ryans explained during his wednesday news conference so just to help spark things more i m going to take over the play calling for the defense and i m gonna make sure that communication is right if our guys are saying communication is not right then ultimately it falls on me so it s on me to get it fixed it s no slight against coach burke he s done an outstanding job just want to make sure i can streamline communication in the best way possible so that isn t the theme when i stand up here the next time i see you guys and talking about communication houston had previously finished as the no 1 and no 6 ranked defenses in 2025 and 2024 under the direction of ryans and burke houston s dc since 2023 but their uncharacteristically porous performance especially in big moments has prompted ryans to take control of the unit it s a tough decision to make also as a head coach i have a lot of tough decisions i have to make ryans said my decisions are not always a popular opinion i m not in this role to please a lot of people s opinion i have to do what s best for this team and make sure i m leading in that way and unfortunately everybody isn t happy when you make changes when you make decisions from my chair everybody isn t happy and that s ok because i know everything that i try to do and strive to do is for the men in that locker room to give those guys the best chance possible to go out and win our first football game through four weeks houston has made a habit of surrendering late leads the texans gave up a seven play 96 yard touchdown drive to josh allen and the buffalo bills in the final three minutes of week 1 s 36 31 loss in week 3 the texans allowed the colts to cover 29 yards in six plays moving into kicker spencer shrader s range for a game winning field goal moments after quarterback c j stroud led a touchdown drive to gain a late lead their latest defeat was the final straw after taking a 23 13 lead early in the third quarter houston allowed the cowboys to claw their way back into the fight in the fourth quarter before responding with a nine play 87 yard touchdown drive that appeared to position the texans to secure their first win of 2026 the same issue resurfaced though when houston s defense allowed a final minute touchdown to dak prescott and the dallas cowboys who drove 74 yards with relative ease in under two minutes for the game winning score a 12 yard pass from prescott to ceedee lamb at 0 4 ryans team has its backs firmly pressed against the wall only one team in nfl history the 1992 san diego chargers have reached the postseason after such a terrible start ryans couldn t afford to repeat the same process and expect a different result as coach and strategic ceo ryans is taking on the responsibility with the hope it will inspire change the texans visit the 0 4 tennessee titans on sunday in week 5

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Eagles trade Cam Jurgens, 2027 seventh-round pick to Ravens for '27 fifth-rounder, '28 second-rounder
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles traded center Cam Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick to the Baltimore Ravens in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round selection and a 2028 second-rounder, the teams announced Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the ravens are throwing more resources at their center conundrum baltimore has acquired cam jurgens in a trade with the philadelphia eagles sending a 2027 fifth round selection and a 2028 second round pick to philadelphia for the nebraska product the ravens are also receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in the deal the teams announced wednesday jurgens arrived to philadelphia as a second round pick in 2022 and the chosen successor to franchise legend jason kelce who assisted general manager howie roseman in the pre draft scouting process for the position and identified jurgens as his ideal replacement jurgens had to wait until kelce retired after the 2023 season to step into the first string role starting 16 games in 2024 and earning a pro bowl nod the first of two he returned to the pro bowl in 2025 despite an ideal fit and time to acclimate jurgens promise never quite matched his production he started strong ranking in the upper half among his counterparts in 2024 per pro football focus and signed a four year 68 million extension in 2025 but battled health challenges that required surgery that offseason in 2026 an injury to guard landon dickerson prompted coach nick sirianni to slide jurgens over to replace dickerson producing nightmarish results that included a second to last pff grade through four weeks jurgens wasn t the lone culprit amid philadelphia s offensive line challenges which also included right tackle lane johnson s week 4 absence and surprise retirement on tuesday the eagles willingness to part with jurgens signals they d rather move in a different direction though ending an experiment that began with promise in 2022 and fizzled by 2026 baltimore has been desperate for help at the pivot since tyler linderbaum left for las vegas in free agency veteran danny pinter began camp as linderbaum s replacement but suffered a season ending injury before the regular season began jovaughn gwyn subsequently rose to the starting role and suffered a fibula fracture that will keep him out for multiple months and a flier taken on veteran ethan pocic another experienced center coming off an injury failed to stick after pocic suffered a knee injury with all three on injured reserve the ravens needed an immediate replacement dialing philadelphia to acquire a former day 2 pick at a relatively high price in jurgens who would have an opportunity to return to center with a team that has serious super bowl aspirations he ll need to get up to speed quickly especially with the possibility that he ll be snapping to backup quarterback tyler huntley in the coming weeks following lamar jackson s ankle injury suffered in week 4 jurgens self reported concussion symptoms on monday and is in concussion protocol ahead of baltimore s week 5 game against the falcons

news_mentions.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye, Panthers WR Tetairoa McMillan highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Carolina second-year wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan and New England third-season quarterback Drake Maye earned top offensive honors for their Week 4 performances.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 4 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week maye bounced back in a big way throwing for three touchdowns to lift his patriots past the bills 29 26 on sunday in an afc east tilting upset in addition to his trio of td tosses maye also had 269 passing yards a 97 7 passer rating and 54 rushing yards each of the aforementioned tallies were season highs for maye who collected his second career afc offensive player of the week honor nfc offensive player of the week mcmillan won ap nfl offensive rookie of the year last season but he might well have had an even bigger coming out party on sunday night in the panthers impressive 32 26 win over the lions an unstoppable force in his first sunday nighter mcmillan caught a pair of touchdowns including a beautiful 32 yarder and produced career bests with 14 receptions and 192 yards it all added up to mcmillan s first player of the week recognition afc defensive player of the week earning his fourth career player of the week nod oluokun was all over the field in the jaguars 22 17 victory over the bengals on sunday oluokun posted seven tackles an interception and forced a fumble for the afc south s first place jags nfc defensive player of the week nobody had a bigger or longer play in the giants 36 24 win over the cardinals on sunday and nobody has run faster with the ball this season than banks with new york clinging to a 30 24 lead banks nabbed an interception and raced 98 yards the other way for six points reaching 21 85 mph which is the fastest a ball carrier has run this season per next gen stats banks also had four tackles and four passes defensed as the 2023 first rounder recorded his first pick six en route to earning his first career player of the week award afc special teams player of the week araiza punted five times in the chiefs 30 27 win over the raiders on sunday and each of them landed inside the 20 yard line araiza averaged 47 6 yards per punt placing one inside the 5 yard line and also rushed for 12 yards on a fake punt nfc special teams player of the week the vikings didn t need to score any touchdowns to defeat the dolphins 15 10 on sunday and remain undefeated on the season at 4 0 they had reichard who posted all of minnesota s points on a perfect 5 for 5 day on field goals his makes came from 47 50 33 41 and 29 yards the 2025 all pro is a perfect 12 of 12 on field goals and 6 for 6 on extra points this year and the third year booter has now earned his second career nfc special teams player of the week nod

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 4 games: Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) exit
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 4 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 4 sunday arizona cardinals safety andrew wingard knee and guard isaiah adams ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the giants tight end hunter long knee did not return offensive tackle paris johnson suffered a biceps injury and was wearing a sling in the locker room following the game per espn baltimore ravens cornerback marlon humphrey calf was ruled out of sunday s win over the titans quarterback lamar jackson ankle did not return buffalo bills wide receiver dj moore aggravated his shoulder injury in sunday s loss to the patriots but it is not currently considered a long term issue espn s adam schefter reported defensive back te 39 cory couch hamstring defensive lineman ed oliver knee and cornerback dee alford ankle did not return carolina panthers offensive tacklemonroe freeling knee was injured in the third quarter and later ruled out chicago bears running back kyle monangai injured his thumb in sunday s win over the jets head coach ben johnson said cincinnati bengals wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was ruled out after he suffered a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to the jaguars denver broncos cornerbacks patrick surtain ankle and riley moss ribs were ruled out of sunday s loss to the 49ers wide receiver pat bryant ankle was carted to the locker room in the third quarter and did not return head coach sean payton did not have any injury updates following the game detroit lions cornerback rock ya sin left sunday night s game with a hamstring injury green bay packers linebacker edgerrin cooper achilles was ruled out of sunday s win over tampa bay head coach matt lafleur told reporters after the game that he suspects that cooper will miss the remainder of the season cornerback brandon cisse neck did not return and was evaluated for a concussion houston texans cornerback jaylin smith hamstring was ruled out of sunday s loss to dallas jacksonville jaguars safety caleb ransaw knee did not return to sunday s win over the bengals kansas city chiefs wide receiver rashee rice hamstring was injured in the first quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the raiders head coach andy reid described rice s injury as a tweak wide receiver tyquan thornton who was carted off the field during sunday s game suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday night thornton will undergo a full evaluation monday morning and is out indefinitely las vegas raiders wide receiver jalen nailor concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the chiefs los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey foot and offensive tackle joe alt neck were ruled out of sunday s loss to the seahawks offensive tackle rashawn slater ankle and cornerback donte jackson hamstring did not return los angeles rams wide receiver konata mumpfield shoulder did not return to sunday s win over philadelphia miami dolphins defensive back reese taylor quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to the vikings minnesota vikings offensive lineman donovan jackson knee was ruled out of sunday s win over the dolphins offensive lineman christian darrisaw was evaluated for a concussion in the second half and did not return new england patriots wide receiver mack hollins calf and tight end eli raridon ankle did not return to sunday s win over the bills new york giants wide receiver braxton berrios foot defensive lineman chauncey golston and safety jason pinnock were ruled out of sunday s win over arizona new york jets defensive end braiden mcgregor chest was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago philadelphia eagles running back saquon barkley hamstring was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the rams linebacker jonathan greenard ankle was ruled out in the second half cornerback quinyon mitchell knee did not return following the loss head coach nick sirianni would not expand on right tackle lane johnson being inactive due to personal reasons telling reporters he s dealing with a personal matter and that s all i m going to say on that san francisco 49ers fullback kyle juszczyk knee is believed to be dealing with a sprain after he was ruled out of sunday s win over the broncos head coach kyle shanahan said jusczcyk will undergo more testing monday per shanahan cornerback upton stout shoulder will undergo testing monday per shanahan seattle seahawks defensive tackle leonard williams left in the middle of the fourth quarter and did not return to sunday s win over the chargers head coach mike macdonald told reporters postgame that the team will have to see about williams but his injury does not appear serious tampa bay buccaneers linebacker sirvocea dennis ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the packers washington commanders quarterback marcus mariota knee defensive end charles omenihu groin and wide receiver jaylin lane ankle were ruled out of sunday s loss to the colts mariota knee was replaced by athan kaliakmanis in the first quarter tyler owens hamstring did not return

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) to start Sunday vs. Giants after missing two games
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will start for Washington against the visiting New York Giants on Sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow, coach Dan Quinn confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels is returning and not a moment to soon for his washington commanders daniels will start for washington against the visiting new york giants on sunday after missing two games due to a dislocated elbow coach dan quinn confirmed friday quinn added that receiver stefon diggs hamstring won t be available for daniels in his return while terry mclaurin hamstring looked good in his return to practice friday anticipation for a potential daniels comeback came prior to washington s week 4 game in london against the indianapolis colts when he made the transatlantic flight with the team ultimately daniels was ruled out and his backup marcus mariota was injured in the defeat which dropped washington to 1 3 daniels who dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys practiced fully on wednesday and thursday a good indicator he d return sunday when he ll be backed up by seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis kaliakmanis made his impromptu debut in relief of mariota against the colts now daniels the ap nfl offensive rookie of the year in 2024 will be looked on to reverse course for washington which is coming off a disastrous 5 12 2025 that seems to be bleeding into 2026 daniels has missed 12 of the commanders last 21 games over two games this season he has largely underwhelmed completing 29 of 51 passes 56 9 for 260 yards and three touchdowns with 100 yards on 12 carries in a pair of defeats since joining the franchise as the no 2 overall selection of the 2024 nfl draft daniels is 14 12 as a starter the overwhelming majority of those wins came during his 12 4 rookie campaign that 24 season in which washington advanced to the nfc championship game seems like a lifetime ago now but the commanders have gone 4 8 without daniels in the past two years thus his return is a very welcomed one with further hope that he ll return to past phenomenal form against the first place giants 3 1

news_mentions.description: NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL. Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the nfl visit nfl com s transaction hub for a daily breakdown injuries ot paris johnson a 2023 first round pick suffered a torn biceps and will miss the remainder of the season head coach mike lafleur said game day elevations s jammie robinson injuries ot jake matthews groin was ruled out at the onset of the second half on monday night against the saints olb za 39 darius smith concussion was ruled out during the first half on monday night smith is in the concussion protocol head coach kevin stefanski confirmed postgame injuries qb lamar jackson coach jesse minter didn t have an update on the nature of jackson s ankle injury but said monday he doesn t expect the qb s absence to be crazy long term depth chart news qb tyson bagent will start against green bay in week 5 coach ben johnson said on espn 1000 radio tyson will be the guy and we ll go forward from there johnson said bagent was 25 of 34 passing for 268 yards and an interception in chicago s week 4 win caleb williams is still sidelined with his hamstring injury injuries wr ja 39 marr chase is in the league s concussion protocol coach zac taylor said wr tee higgins adductor is considered day to day per taylor injuries wr ceedee lamb thigh was listed as a full participant for monday s walk through game against the bills after missing week 4 with a back injury roster cuts rb carlos washington injuries ot christian darrisaw is in the league s concussion protocol coach kevin o connell said monday g donovan jackson suffered a torn meniscus and will likely miss the rest of the regular season per o connell jackson requires surgery for his knee injury roster cuts wr jeshaun jones retirements de marcus davenport is retiring from the nfl after eight plus seasons nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo reported his retirement comes after asking the bears to release him from their practice squad following his appearance in chicago s 23 12 win over the jets on sunday davenport 30 was a 2018 first round pick of the saints and played his first five seasons for new orleans injuries news_mentions.description: Could Jameis Winston be the answer to managers' QB woes? Do the Steelers have a breakout receiver? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 5.
news_mentions.body_text: fantasy managers make plans the football gods laugh the first month of the season has taught us plenty yes brock purdy is that guy no that wasn t too early to draft brock bowers and yes kenneth walker is that good as a lead back it has also left us with plenty of questions why does nate adkins lead the broncos in touchdowns do i have to bench marvin harrison for dohnte meyers am i the worst fantasy drafter of all time not to mention bye week season is officially upon us you started tetairoa mcmillan last week and were gifted with the highest scoring fantasy output of the year good for you now find someone on waivers to replace him this week that s where the sleepers column comes in between injuries and byes sudden absences create uncertainty in your lineup so i ll keep trying my best to give you those sneaky plays that might just win you a week note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses
